chapters.title: Chapter 101: The Abduction
paragraphs: "Before killing him we have to get some information out of him. I doubt he would have left this kingdom without taking his mother along according to the reports we had received about him, so it is fine we will go forward with the plan.
Kidnap his mother and take her hostage, once he return our interrogation will get much easier that way, he will come running to us himself." Tier five assassin said.
"But isn’t the castle off limits, sir?" the other tier 4 assassin asked respectfully.

"This mission is special, just don’t cause any trouble and after getting your target return, no one will hinder your mission there," the leader said calmly, even he couldn’t understand why a person from the Nine Pacts would put so much importance on this mission when their target was so weak.

"I understand, we will do our best even if our task is as simple as taking a woman away from the temple and bringing her here," first tier 4 assassin said. They discussed matters of the mission for a while longer before the group disappeared into the shadows.
A total of twenty seven assassins headed towards the castle in the dead of the night, it was already midnight but as they came out of the underground base the market outside was still quite busy.
All the assassins ran at very fast speed and quickly got close to the capital, unlike the previous location the capital was rather quiet.
People remained hidden especially because of the news of the attack on the king they had received, even a golden knight died so most of the people were scared and didn’t dare to go out at night.

The group of assassins arrived in the capital not long after, while they remained completely hidden, there were many strong people in the capital who could sense them but most of them either worked for the king or just wouldn’t get involved in anything unnecessary.
So without any hurry the group of assassins dressed in black dress with only their eyes visible ran close to the castle, it wasn’t long before they arrived at the boundary.

Even as they entered into the boundary the strong guards who were able to sense their presence just ignored it as they had been ordered, so the assassins group didn’t receive any hindrance and easily they arrived close to the temple.

"We have received the exact location of our target, do your best not to cause any kind of trouble; especially the Goddess or her followers, don’t mess with them," the tier 4 assassin said as they were about to enter the temple.
All the others nodded, who among them could even go against the goddess? If they were to go against her none of them would survive.

"Since this part is quite easy, all of you just surround the place and make sure no problem arises, I will take the target." After ordering, the first looked at the second tier 4 and nodded: "Let’s go."

More than a couple dozen shadows climbed up to the temple and all of them moved close to Vritra and Vanessa’s room, only the two tier 4 assassin were going inside while the others just surrounded the room from all sides.

Vanessa slept inside the room, with her current strength she couldn’t sense any kind of danger. While the goddess was a bit too far to sense the faint killing intent, she had put guards there to watch over all the people living in the temple currently especially Vanessa but even those guards pretended not to notice anything.

The two strong assassins easily stepped inside the room through the window without any difficulty, they still felt it was an overkill; sending the two of them for a mission as easy as abducting a weak woman or killing a weak boy.
"Take her, then we will hurry back to the base," first assassin said, as the two stepped in the room.

They carefully swept their gaze over the surrounding and didn’t sense any kind of danger, there was absolutely no protection for her. Then their gazes moved towards the bed but they noticed that the room was unusually dark, as assassins they had no problem in seeing in darkness but inside this dark room they couldn’t see anything two steps ahead of them, let alone the bed.
"Do you think it is some kind of spell?" the second tier 4 asked, his brows furrowed while he became more alert.
"Whatever may be the case, let’s hurry and leave," the first said as they walked towards the bed.
Suddenly a silhouette rose in the darkness, its body reaching over seven feet and a dark armor surrounded its body while a long sword rested on the silhouette’s waist.
The Dark Knight!!

Two eyes glowed as a chilly sensation swept over the two assassins, they turned around in haste while taking out their blades and placing them in front of their body to block any kind of attack, the two men had suddenly felt such a strong killing intent.
WHOOSH
The dark knight took one step forward while its right hand rested over the hilt of the sword, the sword was drawn at an extremely fast speed that the two assassins didn’t even notice.
Then half of the blade of the first assassin along with the upper half of his head was cut from the middle, his eyes widened in shock and fear but then darkness completely overtook his vision.

The cut was so clean that not even a drop of blood leaked, then darkness swallowed the still standing corpse not letting out any kind of disturbance. The second 4th tier assassin wasn’t killed, the dark knight only knocked it out for now.
After all, master needed one of these bugs to get information from.
In less than three seconds, both the assassins had disappeared from the room. One was dead while the other was kept alive, then the dark knight turned into a blur as it left the room.

The assassin standing right outside the door all of a sudden felt something clutching his head from behind and then his head was crushed as blood, brain matter and skull’s pieces splattered all over but were swallowed by the darkness.
Dark knight didn’t draw its sword as it ripped the assassins apart with its bare hands. The next assassin had its heart ripped out, one was torn into two from the waist.
It moved all around the room and tore the assassins one by one, murdering them all brutally, but not even giving them the chance to scream.
Within a few seconds, the dark knight had killed all the twenty six assassins, without letting out any kind of sound and no traces of them could be found.

After the work was done, the dark knight simply disappeared into the shadows as it continued to protect Vanessa, for a moment it even had the urge to kill those guards who had put its master’s family in danger but after thinking, the dark knight decided not to... for now.
Vanessa didn’t even notice anything as she slept peacefully, having a sweet dream in which she and Vritra flew all over the world, holding hands and becoming very close.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: The Curse
paragraphs: Dawn Minion had failed to complete their task, their assassins disappeared, who were directly assumed dead since they didn’t return until the morning.

The assassin group of course became more cautious, but they didn’t send more assassins to this mission immediately and decided to get more information first. Unknowingly, they had actually looked down upon their target and had paid the price for it.
But this was just the start...
Vritra sat in one of the corners of the cave, hungrily devouring the demon meat from his inventory. His body had already recovered to the peak state after resting for a bit—both his mind and body.
BOOOOOOOOM!!

Every few seconds, the sound of loud explosions rang out that shook the whole place. BOB moved according to Vritra’s instructions, rolling at full thrust and ramming into BOB 2 with destructive force without holding back.

BOB 2 wasn’t unscathed when he previously fought with the alive BOB, and now under the effects ofForbiddenandBlood Lock, the situation had completely changed. Although at first BOB 2 was still at a slight advantage, soon it began to lose ground.

Vritra just had to control BOB. All the injuries it received upon clashes were instantly healed by using its energy, which is one of the perks of a soul wraith. When its energy got dangerously low, Vritra just needed to fill it back by transferring his mana, which he could do without even touching when they were in close proximity.

"Sigh, I don’t even know what to expect anymore. I have never heard of anyone killing a legion or Myriad when there is such a large level difference. Just level near 500 killing a Myriad? Well two, considering another one is about to get added to the list.

That kind of sounds absurd, even if you had used tactics to do so," Yasmine spoke, shaking her head. A big credit of which went to his fast thinking, perfect calculations, and those terrifying abilities.

"Heh, soon we will have two such strong soul wraiths. I guess I can now go all out with my revenge. I have delayed it for far too long already," Vritra mumbled, thinking of all the people who had nearly got him killed.
From king, commander, guards, his classmates, and not to mention... the Nine Pacts—all of them would be paying the price for it.
One or so hour had passed, and BOB 2’s combat strength and every ability had been weakened by more than thirty percent, as it began to lose very badly against BOB.
"Wait, now that I think about it, why hasn’t the message popped out yet? Haven’t I already killed one of them? Shouldn’t the quest already be clear?" Vritra thought in confusion.

"Yes, the quest is completed, but it doesn’t show so yet, which means the quest will most probably be upgraded since you would be slaying both the BOBs—which just means a higher reward for us, hubby, hehe," Yasmine replied with a giggle. She still felt a little weak, but soon she would be fine.

"That’s good to know, but... sigh, this is just the second plane and already so dangerous. I wonder how many more challenges I will have to go through after this. Oh right, I still have to find the door to move to the next plane still."
Vritra stretched his arms and pondered where the door could be. He had already passed through so many caves but had not seen anything out of the ordinary.
"Ah right, what is that field thing in BOB’s status panel? And why were its stats so high?" Vritra asked curiously.
"Those stats are perfectly fine. After crossing through the thousand-level mark, the stats increase exponentially.
My stats were much higher when I had reached that level a long time ago. Anyway, that field— it is a bit hard to explain— but it is kind of a mastery in anything.

It could be elemental attributes, abilities, or anything, like your dust abilities which are comprehended once you have arrived at level 1000. This field greatly defines how strong someone will be in the later stages," Yasmine explained.

"I see, I wonder what it will be for me. Anyway, I am curious about one more thing... these quests, do all people receive them or is it kind of different with me because of any of my abilities?" he questioned.
"Yeah, others receive them too, but they are kind of rare. But you just arrive at special places, so you already got two. Normally, people wouldn’t even see one in their life," she answered calmly.
Yasmine had previously cleared a few quests, so she didn’t think too much about it—but others would have been shocked by this.
"...Uhm, do you happen to know who exactly is controlling this all? Is it that divine, or the true gods?" Vritra asked hesitantly. He had always tried not to think of this topic.

Yasmine remained silent for a few seconds, then she replied: "... I am not sure either, but even the true gods—those terrifying entities—can’t control all of this. They could give abilities, curses, and such things to people, but they can’t even control the status window.

As for this Divine, I think it should be someone on the level of those Gods." She added, but didn’t want to talk about this topic for now, since if she accidentally said anything she shouldn’t, then Vritra might be exposed to those gods—both good and evil—and might even be punished for no reason.
Vritra nodded and didn’t continue the topic.
After over ten minutes, finally, the long-awaited messages popped in front of Vritra.
[You have killed a Level 1011 Ball of Brutality.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]

The moment BOB 2 had died, an invisible change occurred in the entire space as a wave passed through the entire plane. No one noticed it, not even Vritra or Yasmine, as it swept over all the people present in the plane.
Vritra’s complete focus was on the messages that kept popping one after another, without stopping for a few seconds.
[Quest: Survive against and Kill both of the Balls of Brutality has been completed.]
[Reward: You have obtained two Myriad Armors, made from the Balls of Brutality, corresponding to their levels; with protection of their field abilities.]
And then...
[The Cursed Hunter Activated!!]
[The Divine’s curse has been negated.]
Vritra was again filled with confusion by several things, as he muttered in surprise.

"Wait, both the BOBs were at the same level—then why was there such a big difference in their strength? No wait, before that—I received two armors? Field abilities have been added as well for protection? No no no, before all that, what is this curse? Did it get activated because I had killed them both?"

Yasmine was surprised as well. She wasn’t affected since she didn’t possess a body, but thankfully, Vritra was saved because of that title. It wasn’t a simple title—obtaining it was near impossible for most.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Virtue and Benevolence
paragraphs: Aside from Yasmine and Vritra, all the others must have been affected by the curse already.
"Should I go ahead to see what happened to others?" Vritra wondered, but then he decided to do so later. There was something much more important to do.
Stars appeared in his eyes as he looked at the second corpse of the Myriad creature. He drank some water and stood up, his belly full from eating so much meat.
"Time to get to work..." Vritra rubbed his palms together and then began to drink one mana potion after another as he called out:
"EXTRACT!!"
After several minutes of tiresome struggle, Vritra finally managed to obtain an even stronger Soul Wraith, which he namedBobby.
Vritra sat on the ground and felt quite exhausted. Raising such a strong Soul Wraith with his current level was too tough, but it was greatly rewarding.
"Now, let’s see how strong Bobby is compared to Bob."
Race: Ball of Brutality
Name: Bobby
Level: 1011
Vitality: 100%
Field: SPACE
Stats:
Strength: 12,792 Agility: 14,101 Endurance: 17,001 Intelligence: 10,995 Mana: 10,028

"Oh, despite being at the same level, there is quite a difference between their stats. Bobby is much stronger than Bob," Vritra mumbled as he looked at the dark, large ball that was constantly emitting a dark fog.
"Bobby, can you change your size?" Vritra asked, and in the next moment, its size suddenly enlarged and then became very small—nearly the size of a pinky finger.
Even in its small size, the aura it emitted was quite dangerous. Its combat strength didn’t weaken despite the change in size.
After a moment, he decided to give something a try.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

Vritra’s body disappeared from space. He walked around Bobby, and the ball that was reaching up to his waist followed his movements, which didn’t surprise him since Vritra already knew it could track him even in his disappearing state.
"Try hitting my hand lightly," Vritra commanded as he extended his right hand. Previously he didn’t dare do this kind of test, since failure meant death, but now he could do so without any care.

Bobby rotated and jumped towards Vritra’s palm at a slow speed, and it just passed through his body. So even this Myriad creature, who had just started to comprehend the attribute of space as its field, could at most sense his presence but couldn’t actually hurt him as long as he stayed in the Fourth Dimension.
"Sigh..." Vritra sighed. He suddenly felt a lot safer. It seemed the skills he obtained from the Divine Sin Wheel couldn’t be countered so easily; it was very great to know that.
He didn’t regret, nor did he want to complain that he had run all over the place even though those creatures wouldn’t have been able to touch him anyway.
He had to be careful against monsters that strong, but it was satisfying to know that his skill worked even against Legion or Myriad creatures.

"So I was never in mortal danger, at least not for a short while. But eventually... once my mana potions ended, I would have been dead. And until then, I would have been trapped here." Vritra spoke, fully satisfied with how things had turned out despite all the difficulties.
He glanced at his status window to see how much he had levelled up after killing two Myriad creatures.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 10)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: A) [SSS+(?)]
Stats:
Strength: 1647 (+100)
Endurance: 1366 (+100)
Intelligence: 977 (+100)
Luck: 60
[Allocation Points: 94]

"Whoa, I have gained over ninety-four levels?!! That’s huge considering how difficult it became to gain even a single level. I had to kill so many demons just to gain each level... well, this just shows how terrifying these two creatures were." Vritra mumbled, but then he began to wonder.
"Where should I invest these allocation points? Previously, I would have just dumped them all into agility, but now intelligence is needed in my skills and it is the lowest currently."

EvenForbiddendepends on his intelligence stat. The higher it is, the greater the effect it will show on the opponent. What he didn’t know was that his worry about all this was about to be removed forever.
After slight hesitation, he put all the points into intelligence, making it...
Intelligence: 1,071 (+100)
"Alright, that looks nice. Now let’s go and see how everyone else is doing." Vritra spoke, as Bobby disappeared into his shadow.
But just as he was bringing a mana potion out of his inventory, he noticed two new items that had appeared there out of nowhere.
The twoMyriad Armorswith slight spatial protection, whose level shouldn’t be lower than 1,011.
Vritra pulled one of the armors out and looked at it. Upon gazing at it, nothing seemed special about the armor—it was just an almost transparent full-body suit, or so it seemed.

Without thinking much, Vritra put it over his body. The armor disappeared instantly and felt as if a faint layer of invisible energy had appeared all over his body. It was there but couldn’t be seen or touched.
"Is the armor really there? Is it working fine?" Vritra wondered. He couldn’t feel much change himself, but it was definitely present there.

"Yes, it is working perfectly. It is a spatial kind of armor, so even if it is invisible, it is there. And weapons or armors possessing even slight Field attributes are much better than others at the same level. This will increase your defence by several times.

No one under the Legion or Myriad could hurt you unless they have some very special means, of course." Yasmine spoke. Since the quest got upgraded, the reward’s grade and number had increased as well.
"Oh nice, a good armor." Vritra felt quite satisfied with his harvest already in this tomb. He decided to give the other armor to his mother—that way, he would feel a bit better.
"Let’s go." Finally, he flew back towards the entrance of the second plane, and as he drew closer, he began to hear strange noises from there.
There were screams, battle cries, crying, and much more. Feeling confused, Vritra increased his speed as he soon stopped in front of the utterly chaotic place.
The scene was truly baffling. On his left was theNine Pact, and on the right was theGolden Moon.

The things Vritra saw truly left him speechless. The people from the Golden Moon were at each other’s necks and even attacking the people from the Nine Pacts. They were cursing loudly and looked as evil as the word goes.
While on the other side, most of the people from the Nine Pacts were on their knees. Some prayed to God, some chanted words of forgiveness and benevolence.
They begged Gods to forgive them for all their sins—even Number One and the other leaders of the Nine Pacts appeared so righteous and virtuous that they looked like pure and good people.
Such that they would never even hurt a fly.
The third leader was especially benevolent and down to earth.

sentences.text: Aside from Yasmine and Vritra, all the others must have been affected by the curse already.
"Should I go ahead to see what happened to others?" Vritra wondered, but then he decided to do so later.
There was something much more important to do.
Stars appeared in his eyes as he looked at the second corpse of the Myriad creature.
He drank some water and stood up, his belly full from eating so much meat.
"Time to get to work..." Vritra rubbed his palms together and then began to drink one mana potion after another as he called out:
"EXTRACT!!"
After several minutes of tiresome struggle, Vritra finally managed to obtain an even stronger Soul Wraith, which he namedBobby.
Vritra sat on the ground and felt quite exhausted.
Raising such a strong Soul Wraith with his current level was too tough, but it was greatly rewarding.
"Now, let’s see how strong Bobby is compared to Bob."
Race: Ball of Brutality
Name: Bobby
Level: 1011
Vitality: 100%
Field: SPACE
Stats:
Strength: 12,792 Agility: 14,101 Endurance: 17,001 Intelligence: 10,995 Mana: 10,028
"Oh, despite being at the same level, there is quite a difference between their stats.
Bobby is much stronger than Bob," Vritra mumbled as he looked at the dark, large ball that was constantly emitting a dark fog.
"Bobby, can you change your size?" Vritra asked, and in the next moment, its size suddenly enlarged and then became very small—nearly the size of a pinky finger.
Even in its small size, the aura it emitted was quite dangerous.
Its combat strength didn’t weaken despite the change in size.
After a moment, he decided to give something a try.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra’s body disappeared from space.
He walked around Bobby, and the ball that was reaching up to his waist followed his movements, which didn’t surprise him since Vritra already knew it could track him even in his disappearing state.
"Try hitting my hand lightly," Vritra commanded as he extended his right hand.
Previously he didn’t dare do this kind of test, since failure meant death, but now he could do so without any care.
Bobby rotated and jumped towards Vritra’s palm at a slow speed, and it just passed through his body.

So even this Myriad creature, who had just started to comprehend the attribute of space as its field, could at most sense his presence but couldn’t actually hurt him as long as he stayed in the Fourth Dimension.
"Sigh..." Vritra sighed.
He suddenly felt a lot safer.
It seemed the skills he obtained from the Divine Sin Wheel couldn’t be countered so easily; it was very great to know that.
He didn’t regret, nor did he want to complain that he had run all over the place even though those creatures wouldn’t have been able to touch him anyway.
He had to be careful against monsters that strong, but it was satisfying to know that his skill worked even against Legion or Myriad creatures.
"So I was never in mortal danger, at least not for a short while.
But eventually... once my mana potions ended, I would have been dead.
And until then, I would have been trapped here." Vritra spoke, fully satisfied with how things had turned out despite all the difficulties.
He glanced at his status window to see how much he had levelled up after killing two Myriad creatures.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 10)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: A) [SSS+(?)]
Stats:
Strength: 1647 (+100)
Endurance: 1366 (+100)
Intelligence: 977 (+100)
Luck: 60
[Allocation Points: 94]
"Whoa, I have gained over ninety-four levels?!!
That’s huge considering how difficult it became to gain even a single level.
I had to kill so many demons just to gain each level... well, this just shows how terrifying these two creatures were." Vritra mumbled, but then he began to wonder.
"Where should I invest these allocation points?
Previously, I would have just dumped them all into agility, but now intelligence is needed in my skills and it is the lowest currently."
EvenForbiddendepends on his intelligence stat.
The higher it is, the greater the effect it will show on the opponent.
What he didn’t know was that his worry about all this was about to be removed forever.
After slight hesitation, he put all the points into intelligence, making it...
Intelligence: 1,071 (+100)
"Alright, that looks nice.
Now let’s go and see how everyone else is doing." Vritra spoke, as Bobby disappeared into his shadow.
But just as he was bringing a mana potion out of his inventory, he noticed two new items that had appeared there out of nowhere.
The twoMyriad Armorswith slight spatial protection, whose level shouldn’t be lower than 1,011.
Vritra pulled one of the armors out and looked at it.
Upon gazing at it, nothing seemed special about the armor—it was just an almost transparent full-body suit, or so it seemed.
Without thinking much, Vritra put it over his body.
The armor disappeared instantly and felt as if a faint layer of invisible energy had appeared all over his body.
It was there but couldn’t be seen or touched.
"Is the armor really there?
Is it working fine?" Vritra wondered.
He couldn’t feel much change himself, but it was definitely present there.
"Yes, it is working perfectly.
It is a spatial kind of armor, so even if it is invisible, it is there.
And weapons or armors possessing even slight Field attributes are much better than others at the same level.
This will increase your defence by several times.
No one under the Legion or Myriad could hurt you unless they have some very special means, of course." Yasmine spoke.
Since the quest got upgraded, the reward’s grade and number had increased as well.
"Oh nice, a good armor." Vritra felt quite satisfied with his harvest already in this tomb.
He decided to give the other armor to his mother—that way, he would feel a bit better.
"Let’s go." Finally, he flew back towards the entrance of the second plane, and as he drew closer, he began to hear strange noises from there.
There were screams, battle cries, crying, and much more.
Feeling confused, Vritra increased his speed as he soon stopped in front of the utterly chaotic place.
The scene was truly baffling.
On his left was theNine Pact, and on the right was theGolden Moon.
The things Vritra saw truly left him speechless.
The people from the Golden Moon were at each other’s necks and even attacking the people from the Nine Pacts.
They were cursing loudly and looked as evil as the word goes.
While on the other side, most of the people from the Nine Pacts were on their knees.
Some prayed to God, some chanted words of forgiveness and benevolence.
They begged Gods to forgive them for all their sins—even Number One and the other leaders of the Nine Pacts appeared so righteous and virtuous that they looked like pure and good people.
Such that they would never even hurt a fly.
The third leader was especially benevolent and down to earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Holy Monk
paragraphs: Among all the people from the Nine Pacts, the third leader was especially benevolent and down to earth, as he pressed his head against the ground and cried like a child, begging for forgiveness from all his victims and their families.

For some reason, it seemed the two sides had changed their roles— but to an extreme level. The people who were evil had turned into the most pure hearted, upright, and chivalrous— the type to follow the teaching that if someone slaps one of your cheeks, you present the other cheek to receive another slap.
They kept muttering things like:
"Oh God, forgive us for the sins we have committed. We shall never even touch a weapon again in our life. We should protect the weak."
"Yes, all our power should be for the weak. We can’t slaughter people like those evil Golden Moon people. Nine Pacts will always protect the people of this world."

While the people who could be considered overall good had turned into such evil psychos that they were attacking people for no reason. They laughed madly and cursed everyone. They became ruthless, morally twisted, and corrupt.

"Kekeke, kill everyone! These weaklings don’t deserve to live. And you bastard, you took money from me and didn’t return it. Now die, and then I will slaughter your family for one silver coin. Kekeke."
"These evil Nine Pacts pigs need to be slaughtered! I am going to kill anyone who comes in front of me— even if it’s these pretentious Golden Moon assholes."
"Protect the weak? Kekeke, nice joke. If you are weak, then you are just begging to be killed."
Such words were shockingly coming from the Golden Moon side. Vritra felt quite strange seeing the two sides act so bizarrely. Then he remembered something.
"Oh right, Monk Shitless. He must have been affected by the curse here, right? He was a monk, so wouldn’t he be much more evil? Sigh... don’t tell me he is killing others too—"

Vritra looked around and soon saw a strange sight. Monk Shitless was on the ground beside his bull. He had prostrated himself on the ground as he shouted the hardest, asking gods for forgiveness for crimes like peeing on the temples and much more.
Vritra: "..."
"T- That bastard is evil despite being a monk?" Vritra let out a flabbergasted scoff. How absurd was that? And he was a strange kind of evil— unlike the Nine Pacts.
"Anyway, what am I supposed to do now? Should I just look for the next door?" Vritra was pondering when the strangely behaving people took notice of him.
It was just a few at first, but upon seeing him, they called out loudly.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +11,003}
"H- He is still alive?!! Then what about those two Myriad creatures? Did they leave?" a Golden Moon member spoke.
Sin points once again began to pour out, making Vritra feel quite nice. Seeing these messages flash was always a satisfying sight.

"It’s that bastard! How can he still be alive? Am I hallucinating? Maybe something has gone wrong with my brain. For a moment I can even believe that the holy Demon Lords are the symbol of evil—but how can he be alive?" a Nine Pacts member shouted.

"Kekeke, let’s kill that hateful, detestable creature! He came back at the right time—I’ve never wanted to kill someone so badly. I will offer his blood to the evil and vile righteous lords," said someone from the Golden Moon.

"Oh forgiving Demon Gods, even though we follow the path of benevolence, forgiveness, and virtue, evil must be erased from this world—especially when it is the epitome of evil, the incarnate of evil, the sinful creature. Please forgive us, for we are about to kill—even if it is to erase darkness from the world," said someone from the Nine Pacts.
"Yes, we have to kill that bastard."
"We are sorry. Will you just let us kill you a bit? Please let us send you to the ever holy Demon Gods. It won’t be painful."
Vritra: "..."
"Hahaha, they all hate you so much that even in that state, all of them had united to kill you—whether good or evil, even the curse can’t break that hatred. This is too funny."

Yasmine laughed hard at this scene. She really loved it when her husband turned on that shameless switch. She even thanked those Demon Lords for using underhanded methods to hurt her so she was able to witness all this.
After a long laugh, she asked in a playful tone, "So Daddy, what are you going to do next?"
Vritra rolled his eyes. He really wanted to give a light spank to her, but he enjoyed her presence and words just as much, so he decided to be virtuous and tolerable.
’I wonder if I was affected by that curse, how would I be behaving? Would I become good or evil?’ he wondered. But before doing anything, he first needed to get the whole situation under control.
Taking in a deep breath, he shouted, "ALL OF YOU SHUT THE FUCK UP!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +9,246}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +10,492}
Because of their crazed state, all the people were stunned—but just for a few moments before the group of thousands charged towards him like moths to flames.
Vritra wasn’t planning to slaughter them all—or at least not yet. These were the tools for farming sin points, and his sin points hadn’t even reached what they were previously yet.

"Exhume." He muttered in a low voice, as two large dark and metallic balls shot out of his shadow and rotated at one point on either side of Vritra. The air suddenly became dense with killing intent, and a heavy pressure descended upon everyone.

All the people froze in their tracks. The fear suppressed all natures—whether good or evil. They just stood there silently with eyes wide open and bodies trembling, as another wave of sin points flowed.
"W- What are these two creatures doing here? And how can this bast— no no I meant the honoured one— control them?" someone muttered.
"All of you pigs, had I not been telling you not to disrespect my lord?! How can you a- all even think of harming the honoured one?" another person chimed in.
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +11,003}
"Nice, just be obedient and you will survive." Vritra nodded his head as his sight moved from left to right and landed on Number One.
"You, step forward." He called out, and Number One froze. He was already quite weak, but even if he was at his peak, how could he have been a match for two terrifying Myriad creatures?
He almost peed his pants just under their aura. All his arrogance and confidence had been wiped away in seconds as he fell to his knees and began to beg.
"S- Sir, please forgive me, just give me another chance. I was a- arrogant before— *SLAP*I was stupid— *SLAP*"
Number One slapped himself again as his mask broke and his nose began to bleed.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Blabber mouth
paragraphs: "S- Sir, please forgive me, just give me another chance. I was arrogant beforeSLAPI was stupidSLAPpower had gotten into my head. Please, I want to live. I can do whatever it is you want. I didn’t even try to kill you. I am begging you, please, just one chance."
Number One slapped himself again as his mask broke and his nose began to bleed.
His face was nothing out of the ordinary—just the face of a man who seemed to be in his thirties, someone who would meld perfectly in a crowd; though his real age must be much higher.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
"Aye, why are you acting like I am some cruel, merciless killer? I just wanted to have a small talk with you. You don’t have to worry like that.

And you are the leader of so many people, the strongest among them all—stand up and be more confident. How could you just kneel in front of anyone?" Vritra said, his tone calm and devoid of any killing intent.
Number One doubted him at first, but upon thinking—if Vritra really wanted to kill him, then he could have just ordered one of the Myriad creatures to do so. There was no need for all this.
"Alright sir, just tell me whatever it is you want to talk about." Number One said, as hope appeared in his eyes.
"It is kind of a secret, so I can’t say it in front of all these people. How about just the two of us talk in that corner?" Vritra pointed towards one corner of the large space.
"Uh... O- Okay." Number One nodded fearfully as he stood up and then followed behind Vritra silently. He was still a little afraid.
Once they arrived out of everyone’s earshot, Vritra was the first to speak.
"So you had two purposes in coming to this place: experiments and the search for this tomb, am I right?"

"Y- Yeah, experiments and the search—we are here for that." Number One nodded hastily. He was sweating profusely as he kept glancing back at the two Myriad creatures, fearing that they might strike at any moment.
"I see, so—" Vritra began to speak, but then saw a new message flash before his eyes.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Tricked +1}
’Haa... this man is so close to death yet he still has the nerve to lie to me?’ Vritra shook his head but continued calmly.
"But it seems there is more to your missions than just experiments and the search. I had heard something interesting. So are you trying to lie to me?"
A killing intent exponentially stronger than before burst out of his body and made Number One’s knees buckle.
"N- No sir, I was a- about to speak..." He took a deep breath and understood that he couldn’t lie at all in this situation, or he might really end up dying.

"Our third and final mission... even I don’t have m- much detail about it. But I know that it was somehow related to the d- demons. I believe they might soon be barging into this kingdom with a large a- army, but I am not sure what their goal exactly is." Number One spoke in haste, and no ’Got Tricked’ message popped.
"Hmm... the demons might be coming to this kingdom. Maybe they are after this tomb too," Vritra wondered.
Number One understood that if he wanted to live, then he would have to be as honest as he could. So after slight hesitation, the small blabbermouth began to throw out one secret after another.

"A- Although it is just a rumour, but they are searching for some key that is said to have been lost in this kingdom a l- long time ago. I think it might be related to this tomb or something even more special," Number One said.
Although Vritra already had an answer in mind, he still asked, "And what kind of key is it?"

"I am not exactly sure, but from what I had heard in those rumours, it is something kept in a black box, which has an almost impossible to solve puzzle. I know nothing more about it." Number One replied honestly.
"Okay, then what do you know about this tomb?" Vritra asked as he tapped at the chin of his mask.

"A- About this tomb, we had gotten an ancient map which showed the location of some great treasure. That was the biggest reason for the Nine Pacts to arrive here. I didn’t receive any other info," Number One answered.
"Alright, now tell me the last question—"
Just as Vritra was about to speak, he heard a distant scream. Without even turning his head, he found that a few psychos from the Golden Moon seemed to have attacked someone.
"P- Pitiful one, save meeeee!!" came the shout from the crowd. It seemed a few people of Golden Moon got annoyed by the light flashing off his bald head and they attacked him at the same time.
Vritra looked at Monk Shitless. The monk raised one of his fingers toward Vritra in the Doctor Strange style, saying this is that one chance.
’Sigh... Bob, go save him but don’t kill anyone—just lightly push them back.’
Vritra ordered, as one of the balls’ size decreased and it appeared in front of the monk, protecting him from all the attacks before bringing the baldy away from the group.
Finally, Vritra’s attention returned to the horrified Number One.
’So h- he really can control those creatures...’ The leader was terrified after finding this. Previously, there was still some doubt in his mind.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"Now tell me a little about those experiments you are conducting." Vritra asked.

"Oh t- those... I don’t really control them. There is a d- doctor in the base of the Nine Pacts who controls all the experiments and reports them back to our h- headquarters. There are several types of e- experiments. I have no knowledge of t- that." Number One replied in a nervous tone.
"Alright, you did very well. Now it is my turn to tell you something important," Vritra said as his lips curled up inside the mask.
"T- Tell me what?" Number One became even more nervous as he heard that.
"You know that your group had even taken the people summoned to this place from another world, right? From a labyrinth, where the king’s men had delivered them to you—dead or alive?" Vritra asked.
"Y- Yes... why do you say that?"
Number One became restless, his fear increasing rapidly, of course he knew about all this.

"My name is Vritra, and I was one of your targets. But miraculously, I survived—though I had to face hell for that. But I have to thank you. Just because of the Nine Pacts and this kingdom’s army, several nice changes happened in my life."
Vritra said, although his words were calm. But Number One was so frightened that he actually leaked a little in his pants.
’So he intended to kill me from the beginning...’
Number One’s mind went blank, his vision becoming blurring and his heart was beating so wildly as if it was about to pop out of his chest.

So after slight hesitation, the small blabbermouth began to throw out one secret after another.
"A- Although it is just a rumour, but they are searching for some key that is said to have been lost in this kingdom a l- long time ago.
I think it might be related to this tomb or something even more special," Number One said.
Although Vritra already had an answer in mind, he still asked, "And what kind of key is it?"
"I am not exactly sure, but from what I had heard in those rumours, it is something kept in a black box, which has an almost impossible to solve puzzle.
I know nothing more about it." Number One replied honestly.
"Okay, then what do you know about this tomb?" Vritra asked as he tapped at the chin of his mask.
"A- About this tomb, we had gotten an ancient map which showed the location of some great treasure.
That was the biggest reason for the Nine Pacts to arrive here.
I didn’t receive any other info," Number One answered.
"Alright, now tell me the last question—"
Just as Vritra was about to speak, he heard a distant scream.
Without even turning his head, he found that a few psychos from the Golden Moon seemed to have attacked someone.
"P- Pitiful one, save meeeee!!" came the shout from the crowd.
It seemed a few people of Golden Moon got annoyed by the light flashing off his bald head and they attacked him at the same time.
Vritra looked at Monk Shitless.
The monk raised one of his fingers toward Vritra in the Doctor Strange style, saying this is that one chance.
’Sigh...
Bob, go save him but don’t kill anyone—just lightly push them back.’
Vritra ordered, as one of the balls’ size decreased and it appeared in front of the monk, protecting him from all the attacks before bringing the baldy away from the group.
Finally, Vritra’s attention returned to the horrified Number One.
’So h- he really can control those creatures...’ The leader was terrified after finding this.
Previously, there was still some doubt in his mind.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"Now tell me a little about those experiments you are conducting." Vritra asked.
"Oh t- those...
I don’t really control them.
There is a d- doctor in the base of the Nine Pacts who controls all the experiments and reports them back to our h- headquarters.
There are several types of e- experiments.
I have no knowledge of t- that." Number One replied in a nervous tone.
"Alright, you did very well.
Now it is my turn to tell you something important," Vritra said as his lips curled up inside the mask.
"T- Tell me what?" Number One became even more nervous as he heard that.
"You know that your group had even taken the people summoned to this place from another world, right?
From a labyrinth, where the king’s men had delivered them to you—dead or alive?" Vritra asked.
"Y- Yes... why do you say that?"
Number One became restless, his fear increasing rapidly, of course he knew about all this.
"My name is Vritra, and I was one of your targets.
But miraculously, I survived—though I had to face hell for that.
But I have to thank you.
Just because of the Nine Pacts and this kingdom’s army, several nice changes happened in my life."
Vritra said, although his words were calm.
But Number One was so frightened that he actually leaked a little in his pants.
’So he intended to kill me from the beginning...’
Number One’s mind went blank, his vision becoming blurring and his heart was beating so wildly as if it was about to pop out of his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Jaw Breaking Battle
paragraphs: ’So he intended to kill me from the beginning.’ Number One’s mind went blank, the dread of death gripped his heart as his vision blurred.
’No, I still have a chance. The two Myriad creatures are too far. If I can kill him before they arrive, I will be able to survive.’
He was so panicked that he really thought he could kill someone who was controlling two Myriad creatures so easily.
{Sin Point Gained: Locked on +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +1}
"Ah y- you were one of them? I- I’m sorry! I wasn’t the one in control of that mission, so please—Die, you bastard!!"
Number One suddenly pulled out his blade and thrust it forward, directly aiming to cut Vritra’s head in two.
His strength might have weakened by fifty percent, but even at level seven hundred he believed Vritra couldn’t survive that blow.

On the other hand, Vritra just stood calmly, making no move at all. A small smile remained on his lips under the mask. This was the perfect chance to test out his new armor. Even if it wasn’t that good, Number One wouldn’t be able to kill Vritra.
WHOOSH
CLANG

The sword hit an invisible surface and the blade paused just a few millimeters away from Vritra’s cheek. It was as if there was an unbreakable and unmovable wall surrounding his body. No matter how much strength Number One put into his attack, he wasn’t able to do anything.

"It is nice," Vritra muttered, and he just allowed Number One to launch attack after attack, but all of them paused just a few millimeters away from his body. It was like a paper stick hitting a metallic wall.
"Well, enough playing around."

Vritra’s expression changed suddenly. The Nine Pacts was one of the reasons he had almost lost his life, and even his mother was so close to death. He wouldn’t spare them even if the gods pleaded for them.
He pulled out a sword from his inventory—a random high grade one he had borrowed from the king’s inventory—then he muttered:
"Forbid: Mana!!"
[Forbidden Activated.]
Number One’s face paled as, all of a sudden, he couldn’t sense or control even a little of his mana. His body felt weak, and his strength seemed to have decreased by a large amount in an instant.
His body shivered violently. He finally remembered... how could this person be weak? He had subdued two Myriad creatures. So should he be scared of those two balls, or of this Monarch of Death?

He was about to plead for mercy when the sword flashed in his eyes, and in the next moment, two arms flew through the air before landing on the ground with weak thuds. Then blood splattered all around with an ear piercing scream.
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +11,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Overwhelmed +11,003}
{Sin Point Gained: Petrified +11,003}

As the heart wrenching screams rang out, even the people from Golden Moon, who were looking around to cause trouble, froze mid action and sat down on the ground like innocent and well behaved puppies.
This scene was too terrifying—the leader of the Nine Pacts group in charge of the Dunshire Kingdom was defeated so easily, and both his arms were cut off in an instant.

Now all of them were truly terrified of Vritra. The group of eleven thousand shivered and regretted ever setting foot in this den of the devil. Those two balls looked so cute—Vritra was the real devil. They had all understood this.
Only Monk Shitless looked excited as he watched Number One get tortured. He truly loved chaos, and that’s why he had even come to such a dangerous place.

The first time he had seen Vritra, he had seen that shadow of endless slaughter and bloodshed. Too much chaos and death. It was to the point that the whole capital was filled with a bloody fate energy, which had attracted Monk Shitless to this kingdom.
This sight was just wonderful...

"Aghhhhh! S- Stooooop! Please spare meeeeeee!!! I am begging you, give— ughhhh— me another c- chance, I don’t want to die— ahhhhh! I—COUGH COUGH— I am s- scared; I will do a- anything. It hurts aaaaaaah!"
The arms were cut cleanly from just above his elbows. He flailed what was left of his arms around while begging pitifully.

Despite watching him scream in pain and beg for mercy, Vritra didn’t feel any pity at all. He had seen what these scums did to other people in that base of theirs—in the name of experiments, they were so viciously tortured.

Their bodies were distorted, fed to insects or other creatures, injected with dangerous liquids, acids, and whatnot. Their bodies melted, exploded, got unknown diseases... Vritra might never forget that disturbing sight.

Seeing Number One only increased his anger even more. Most of all, because of this organization, Vanessa had cut her own wrist and tried to take her life several times. That was what made him even angrier.

After Number One screamed for a while and tried to run away, Vritra’s body flashed as he cut off both his legs. Number One, who was running, suddenly fell forward. At first, he couldn’t understand what had happened, but as he looked back, he was horrified and his screams became even more frantic.
"Sob... J- Just kill m- me! Ahhhhhh! My legsssss! I can’t take this p- pain! Ughhh! H- Help me! Cough cough... somebody, p- please... sob..."
The limbless leader pleaded, but no one even dared to look at him.

Filled with regret and despair, he tried to bite off his own tongue, hoping to end his suffering. But with a whooshing sound, the sword tore through the air and cut across his cheek, as his jaw barely hung from his head.

His voice instantly became distorted, and he was no longer able to speak. The others’ bodies chilled with goosebumps as they watched the whole scene in terror. They could almost feel the pain through those painful wails.

Vritra looked down at the wriggling body for a few seconds, then he plunged the sword into his belly and left it there. With his high vitality, he wouldn’t die immediately—but slowly and very painfully, he would lose his life.
After removing the Forbidden skill, Vritra walked away from Number One’s body. If he could use his mana, then he would be able to stay alive for a bit longer—no matter how much he tried to die.
’That feels quite satisfying, everyone in the Nine Pacts deserve that.’ He thought.
"Exactly, his screams now match those of his victims." Yasmine nodded in satisfaction.
"Now, what were you all saying earlier? Something about killing me?" Vritra asked as he stopped in front of the two organizations.
"N- No sir, we are merely lowly bugs! How dare we even think of something like that?"
The dragon masked man smashed his head against the ground quite hard. His mask cracked— half of it fell, while the other half hung on his face.

He too seemed to be in his thirties, though his real age must be much higher. He should be more than a century or two old. There were wrinkles on his face— for some reason, it seemed he had already reached his limit in strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: The drawing
paragraphs: "S- Sir, no one was planning to kill you." The dragon masked man said.

"Oh, you mean I heard wrong? You want to say I am crazy and deaf? You mean I am disabled? You want to say my future is ruined?" Vritra crossed his arms as he spurted out gibberish and watched the sin points rolling in.

"Wh- What?!! No, definitely not, sir! I didn’t mean any of that. I want to say I am at your command, and you can order me to do w- whatever it is you want." The dragon mask spoke hastily, he was quite panicked. Anyone would rather commit suicide than feel all that.
Vritra decided to stop the nonsense and get started with the search for the next door, but then he noticed that Number One’s screams had become less loud.

He gazed at his body and saw that with his regeneration speed, although his limbs weren’t growing back, the bleeding had almost stopped and he wouldn’t be dying anytime soon—at least not because of those injuries.

’How damn persistent. Like a disgusting cockroach. Heh, well that only makes it more fun to cut him apart again and again.’ Vritra smiled as he walked back toward Number One, who was horrified once again but still could only release unrecognizable noises.
SWISH
Pulling out the sword from his belly, Vritra muttered:
"Forbid: Regeneration."
[Forbidden Activated.]

And Number One’s healing stopped instantly. Then Vritra slashed the sword, his speed slow to make it feel as painful as possible. The first slash landed on his face, leaving behind a gruesome cut, as both his eyeballs were slashed in two and he screamed and rolled frantically.
Then Vritra made several long and slightly deep cuts on his belly before shrugging the blood off the sword and putting it back into his inventory.
’What a pity that I don’t gain experience points by killing humans. But why is that the case? I am now a dragon, so shouldn’t I receive points by killing a human?’

Vritra questioned as he walked away from the screaming and crying Number One. The strong and arrogant man had been reduced to this state in such a short time—all because he indirectly messed with the wrong person.

"The division isn’t like that. It’s either evil or good or just other creatures in existence. Like on one side are the demons and on the other side are humans and some other races. So even as a dragon, you can’t get points by killing humans.

Not to mention your origin is still that of a human, which is almost impossible to erase unless you can return back from the dead. Well, it’s not that simple. As you kill more, you will slowly come to understand it all," Yasmine explained.
’If you kill a human, will you receive experience points?’ Vritra asked after a moment.

"Not really, but demons are different. They get experience points even if they kill others like them. That’s why they grow strong much faster and have such a large population. Sigh." Yasmine answered.
Vritra nodded in understanding. He was yet to meet the proper demons—the ones he had met and killed were only from that labyrinth. They were real, but not at the same time.
"Now all of you are going to look around those caves. Each one will enter a different one and look as far as you can travel. Try to find anything abnormal.
Once you find it, come back immediately to report. Otherwise, you would die an even worse death than him. Also, you have the time until Number One is dead," Vritra announced.
All the people nodded hastily, but they still seemed reluctant, afraid of being killed by entities like BOB.
"Sigh. And don’t worry, there is no danger now, so go right now."
As he spoke again, all the people ran hastily towards different openings and soon disappeared inside.

Vritra sat there as he controlled the dust and attached it to everyone’s body to track their locations and even see faint activities through it. He needed to make sure that none of them slacked off or hid something from him.
Only one person aside from Vritra remained there— it was Monk Shitless, who was sitting on his bull.
"Thank you for saving me earlier, pitiful one. And just as promised, I will help you too."
While speaking, he jumped off the bull and walked closer to Vritra. Then he took out a paper and pen and began to draw something on it.
Then he showed it to Vritra and spoke: "This is the spot that you need to find. Just activate the key there and you will reach your destined place."
Vritra looked at the strange drawing. Inside two large circles, there were dozens of what seemed to be dancing humans—or were they dogs?
He had never put too much hope in this monk, so after a quick glance, Vritra nodded, not asking anything.
"Then this Monk Shitless will be going out to search as well. Goodbye for now, pitiful one. Also, be prepared for the battle to come."
After speaking, Monk Shitless kicked his bull and ran into one of the caves.
"He is always muttering something strange. What exactly is the case with him?" Yasmine wondered.
He wasn’t just a madman, that’s for certain. The few things he had said to Vritra had later made sense.
"So what now? How long do I have to wait? This is kinda boring. BOB and BOBBY, go out and search for something too. Also, try not to kill those people for now."
He commanded, as the two balls that were reaching up to his waist rotated and then went into different directions at full speed.
And so Vritra’s wait began...
One hour... two hours... three hours...

Just like that, over twelve hours had passed, but the search remained fruitless. There were thousands of caves, but despite going through most of them, not a single person was able to locate anything that was out of the ordinary.
Vritra felt a headache. If possible, he didn’t want to waste too much time here; after staying away from his mother, he had started to get really worried about her.
He preferred fighting over such puzzling tests. Despite having over eleven thousand slaves, the result was a failure.

By now, even with his high level, Number One lay dead on the ground; his body in very bad shape. Thankfully, there were no flies or other creatures here to eat his body, so it would be rotting right there for a long time.
"Sigh. All of you are so useless that you weren’t able to find any clue at all? Is there really a need to keep you alive?" Vritra spoke, his voice sounding low yet deafening.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,002}
"Tch. Looks like the two famous organizations are all dogshit—"
While Vritra was cursing the two groups, he paused suddenly at the bizarre thing happening in front of him.

At nearly the same time, blood began to trickle down the noses of all eleven thousand people, while their eyes had started to turn red. They themselves didn’t seem to have noticed their own condition.
All of them stood calmly—no pain, no groans, nothing.
As if they were completely unaware of the sudden change.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Red Lily
paragraphs: ’Is it the effect of the curse as well?’ Vritra wondered, his eyes widening in shock. Then it is quite terrifying. It took over a dozen hours to take effect and no one seemed to have noticed anything.
"Hubby, y- you... why are you bleeding as well?" Yasmine’s bewildered and worried voice sounded in Vritra’s head, jolting him out of his thoughts.

"..." Vritra touched his upper lip and indeed there was blood, though there wasn’t as much as the others. Only a few drops of blood had leaked from his nose, while for others, it was as if a blood tap had been turned on, as blood began to pour down faster.

"Huh? W- Why am I bleeding? What’s going on?" Soon the people began to notice the terrifying changes. They didn’t feel any pain, but they were terrified as they held their noses, yet blood continued to pour out from the space between their fingers.

"S- Sir, did you punish us—?" All the eyes were first drawn towards Vritra. They wondered if he had punished them all for failing their task, but they saw a few drops of blood trickling down on his face as well.
"What’s happening? Ughhh s- so much blood is leaking!!! I am going to die, all of us are going to die. We should never have stepped into this cursed place. What are we going to do?"
All the people panicked. They screamed and prayed. Good and evil had mixed at this point; the fear of death remained the same for both.

"Calm down, everyone. I know what is going on, and I have a plan to get us all out of here." Vritra’s loud voice filled the space, and all the hopeful gazes were drawn towards him, as more sin points poured.
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +11,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +11,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Liked +11,000}
Vritra watched the messages flash by, and as the number of sin points decreased, he spoke:
"Sorry, I lied to everyone. I have no plan and I don’t know a damn thing about this place. All of you are really going to die—a very painful and gruesome death, like a rabid dog’s death."

"..." The whole place fell silent for a few seconds, and only the sound of blood dripping down on the ground like constant rain remained. Everyone stared at the masked man, number 0, and couldn’t help but want to curse.
Though they were all too afraid of him to curse out loud.
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +11,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +11,002}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +11,002}

Yasmine rolled her eyes in exasperation as she spoke in shock: "I can’t believe you are still trying to earn sin points when your life is literally in danger. Let’s first find what is the cause of all this."
Vritra stopped playing around with the two groups. He focused on his surroundings and tried to find the possible cause behind this all.
It certainly wasn’t because of the curse, since he wasn’t affected by that. It was either some kind of aura that was slowly showing its effects or some kind of poison that filled the air.

He was less affected than the others, which meant his body was somehow able to fight against this strange cause—though not completely. And there were only a few resistances that his body currently possessed.
As Vritra thought of this all, he quickly came to the realization that there was a high chance that poison was the cause of this and it might be spread in the air.
"I think there might be poison in the air," Vritra said as a frown appeared on his face. The amount of blood leaking out of his nose was gradually increasing.
While the others were in much worse conditions, they had started to bleed from their ears as well.
"No, it is not the air but the space itself that is having this corroding effect," Yasmine shared her thoughts, as the two came to a realization.
Space. There was a high chance that it was also related to the two BOBs.
Vritra ignored the two groups as his body blurred and he ran towards the location where he had killed the two Myriad creatures.
Within a minute, he arrived there. He paused and looked around carefully, even activating the third eye to not miss a single thing.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
But he found the changes rather easily. At the exact places where the two creatures had fallen, two small flowers were growing out of the ground. They definitely weren’t there before.
They must have grown after Vritra had left. Walking up to the flowers, Vritra looked at them carefully and asked:
"Do you know what this is?"

Yasmine replied almost immediately: "Yeah, it is the Red Sorrow Lily—a flower which only blooms upon the death of the person who had swallowed its seed. It constantly releases corrosive spatial fluctuations, whose effects get more terrifying than any poison in the world.

It is extremely rare. Even I had only come across one in my lifetime, and that sight... I could never forget that. An entire village of thousands of snake people were slaughtered by a single flower within a month in another continent. They all died very painfully.

Their bodies rotted, blood seeped out of their skin, their organs and bones melted.SighIt was a brutal and cruel memory—very inhumane. I don’t know how there could be two of them in this place, and they are growing much faster too."
Her voice was solemn and full of worry as she explained, unlike her usual playful self.
{Sin Point Gained: Bewildered +1}
"Oh!!" Vritra was shocked and took a step back. The flower looked completely harmless and beautiful. Calming his mind and wiping the blood, he asked:
"So should I just pluck it out? Burn it? Tell me how to destroy it."

"No, don’t pluck it at all. That would increase the corrosive effect by several times. The only way is to break the rock around it and then you’ll have to store it in your inventory entirely," Yasmine said hurriedly, worried that he might pluck it out in panic.

"Ah, okay... Damn it. First making me fight these two crazy creatures and giving a quest to kill them. And now that I’ve succeeded with the impossible, the path still leads to death? What kind of wretched place is this?" Vritra cursed as he glanced around.
The stone with which the ground and walls of the cave were made was far from ordinary. Even when the two BOBs had struck the ground again and again with so much force, no crater was formed.
At most, cracks appeared on the ground. There was little chance that with his strength Vritra would be able to do anything in a short time.

"Bob, Bobby, get to work. And no matter what, you can’t hurt these two flowers. We just need to pull out the entire stone surrounding the flowers. Go!!" Under his command, the two balls flew out of his shadow.
Their size increased and became the same as before. They could grow even bigger, but that would make movement harder in this cave. The spikes around their bodies grew and then...
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Roll the wheel!!
paragraphs: BOOOOOOOOOM!!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
They hit the ground around a dozen or so metres away from the flowers as the explosive sound began to ring out like before.
The damn ground was too persistent, even after two hours the task was nowhere near done.

The spikes of Bob and Bobby broke several times, but as soul wraiths they healed instantly. Vritra watched the whole thing silently. He had even created protective layers of dust around the two flowers. He was still mostly fine, but the other people were going crazy.
But because of the tension, Vritra began to devour more and more demon meat, as the Essence Core in his body was being restored and strengthened.
Time passed as the explosive sound became consistent, ringing once every second or two.
After more than fourteen hours of consistent explosions, the large hard rocks around the two flowers were finally broken.
Vritra just stored the two large boulders instantly. By now, even he felt his head buzzing, and it wouldn’t be long before he would start bleeding from his ears and mouth.
Even after the flowers had disappeared, there were still lingering effects, but everything would soon return to normal.
Just as Vritra was about to head back and check on the situation of all the people, he noticed something in the two large holes in the ground that were a few metres apart from one another.

He noticed and saw something like a dancing human or a dog covered under debris and dust. It seemed to be carved into the ground, and even Bob and Bobby weren’t able to scratch it. "Mm hmm, now what is this?"
He jumped into the hole, and with a wave of his hand, he cleared off all the dust from the ground, and the carvings became more visible.
"So it wasn’t that the Monk Shitless’s drawing was bad, the source was just that ugly. Anyway, so this is the right place? Now what kind of key am I supposed to activate?"
Vritra’s lips stretched in a thin line. He took the monk’s words as bullshit, but now he felt that might not have been the case.
"Guess I will go back and ask." He decided and ran back immediately.

"!!!" When he arrived back at that place, the scene was quite shocking. Almost all the eleven thousand people lay on the ground like corpses, their faces and clothes covered in blood, and they were all unconscious.

Vritra quickly spotted Monk Shitless, who was unconscious over his bull. He flew over and pulled the monk to the ground. He was still alive and had only fainted. Vritra pulled out the Death Bringer weapon from his inventory.
The legendary weapon of the warriors of the east, the slipper.
"Shitless, you can’t die yet.SLAP SLAP SLAP SLAPWake up.SLAP SLAP" Vritra shouted as he kept slapping his cheeks with the slipper, hitting quite hard that his cheeks became swollen within seconds.

"Uhm, shouldn’t there be more words and less slaps? Are you trying to wake him up or beat the shit out of him? This is so wrong to do this to a helpless unconscious person, but personally I love it hehe, let’s keep on going." Yasmine had finally relaxed after the earlier shock, her mood became jolly as she spoke playfully.

"I think he is deadSLAP SLAP SLAP SLAP SLAP SLAPyou can’t die, not yet, tell me what was the key,SLAP SLAP SLAP SLAPwhat was it?" Vritra continued to help the poor monk until he heard a barely visible voice coming out of his mouth.
"I- I am still alive ugh cough s- stop I am not dead..." the monk muttered pitifully, he could barely speak with his swollen face.
"You are alright? Forget that, tell me what did you mean by the key?" Vritra asked as he violently shook Monk Shitless’s shoulders.
"I- I don’t know that, I cough just know that y- you have the k- key ughh." Monk spoke with difficulty, his head spinning.
"Tch, so useless." Vritra pushed the monk away and turned. Before leaving, he glanced at all the people and wondered if he should bring them as meat shields to the next round or not.
Who knows what danger might lurk there.
But first, he needed to figure out what the key actually was.
So he arrived back at the place where the drawing was carved under the ground and only a part of it was visible.
He stood above the circular drawing and began to ponder.
"Key, key... the only thing that comes to my mind related to that word is the Sin key—wait, this place is indeed related to the Divine Sin Wheel, so maybe that is the case!!" he concluded quickly.
Vritra glanced at his sin points.
{Sin Point: 2,638,995}
The figure was less than before but still satisfying. The crowd here was less than the competition, and he had spent less time earning sin points here.
He bought a key quickly worth 10,000 sin points.
{Sin Points: 2,628,995}
(Sin Keys available: 1)
After buying the key, he wondered if he needed to put this ethereal key into the drawing somehow or just rotate the wheel once.

He decided to rotate the wheel once. He could waste 10,000 points if it meant finding the door outside. He had already wasted so many sin points already because of ’Better Luck Next Time!!’, so what did 10,000 more matter?
[Used 1 Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 0]
He directly pushed the key into the golden wheel in his mind as the wheel rotated, and just as he had expected, the carvings under his feet began to glow with a bright light.
Vritra had expected that a door would open, but much to his shock, his body began to distort and his head began to spin. He guessed that it might be some kind of teleportation.
But this wasn’t what he wanted, he was just looking for a door.
"Stop stop I have to get my meat shield before, waittttt—" Vritra was shocked as his body became blurry, but before his sight became completely dark, he received yet another shock.
{You have acquired 3,000 Agility stat points.}
"WHAT THE HELLLLLL-?" his voice echoed as he disappeared from the space amidst his shock, his voice lingered a moment in the now empty cave.

As Vritra returned to his senses, he blinked his eyes and felt a slight headache. He slowly opened his eyes and only saw darkness. Absolutely nothing was visible. He couldn’t even see his own body, and the silence was deafening.

Vritra couldn’t even feel anything. There was no land under his feet, and he seemed to be floating in space. He spoke but couldn’t even hear his own voice. He couldn’t even talk to Yasmine despite calling her name out several times.

’What’s going on? Am I dead? If I am not wrong, then I must have been teleported to another space, but what is this place? I can’t sense anything at all.’ His own thoughts felt as if he was listening to someone else speak.
He opened his status window to see if the last thing he saw was just an illusion or reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Resting place
paragraphs: Stats:
Strength: 1647 (+100)
Endurance: 1366 (+100)
Intelligence: 1071 (+100)
Luck: 60
[Allocation points: 0]
’Damn, so I really got a reward on the very first try? What kind of luck was that? And THREE THOUSAND AGILITY POINTS?!! That’s almost twice my stat.

Plus, even the stat couldn’t be seen as two hundred is double of hundred in terms of strength, each stat point is a great addition on its own.’ Vritra was pleasantly surprised at such a gain. He didn’t think for a moment that he could actually obtain anything.
He looked around and saw nothing. He tried to move but couldn’t. Moments passed and soon several minutes had passed, yet the concept of time seemed meaningless here.
’What if I spin again? Will I get something else?’ Vritra wondered as an expectant smile appeared on his face.
{Sin Points: 2,618,995}
(Sin Keys available: 1)
[Used 1 Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 0]
{Better Luck Next Time!!}

Vritra sighed, but he wasn’t saddened by this message. He had expected that. Still, he was quite happy with so many stat points. His speed, reaction time, and such things had just become several times better. This was a huge upgrade.
Just as the last message had popped in front of him, Vritra saw a light flash exactly in front of him. He closed his eye for a moment, then opened and saw something bright in front of him.
As his vision adjusted, he was able to clearly see it. It looked like the hand of a clock—a very stylish clock—gold coloured and appearing very exquisite.

’Is this the Divine Sin Arrow? Was that the last test? Wait, if I didn’t have any sin points, wouldn’t I be stuck in this darkness until I died?’ Vritra felt a chill. Then he hesitatingly extended his right hand towards the long arrow.
Just as his fingers touched it, several messages flashed in front of him.
[You have obtained the Divine Sin Arrow.]
[Would you like to merge it with the Divine Sin Wheel?]
"...Yes," Vritra spoke, believing that there shouldn’t be any harm in doing so.
Just as he spoke, the golden arrow broke into energy particles and was absorbed into his body, as everything became dark again.
[Merging process has started.]
[Progress: 0.00%]
[Time left: 3 days.]
"..." Vritra read the messages, the only thing he could currently see.

’Three days? That’s a bit long. Guess I will have to wait.’ Vritra didn’t think too much about it. He had already obtained quite a lot from this trip—even if it isn’t that good, he wouldn’t be at a loss.
"Now, how do I get out of this place?" he mumbled, and decided to use the key again that brought him here, as he bought another sin key.
{Sin Points: 2,608,995}
(Sin Keys available: 1)
[Used 1 Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 0]
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
Once again, Vritra went through the same experience as he soon found himself standing on that exact spot, on the carving drawing.
"I am back!!" Vritra exclaimed and looked down at himself. Everything seemed perfectly fine.
"What just happened? I couldn’t sense anything. Where were you teleported?" Yasmine asked. She too was in complete darkness just moments ago.
"I got the Divine Sin Arrow. I don’t know where I was earlier. Anyway, it is time to return home," Vritra replied. He just wanted to run back to the temple.
"Yeah, let’s go. I’m missing my cute mother in law as well," Yasmine said.
While the two chatted, Vritra made his way back to the door. By now most of the people had regained their consciousness, and they were drinking healing potions and already looking much better.
None of them tried to leave even though the door was already open. They didn’t notice any changes.

Vritra stared at them for a few seconds. He had obtained enough sin points from them, so there was no need for them anymore. He had already planned to wipe out everyone from the Nine Pacts, but he wasn’t sure about the Golden Moon. After all, he didn’t have any problem with them.

’Do you think I should spare them or just kill them all?’ Vritra asked. Silencing all of them here and now might be good, but killing so many of both organizations might just pull much more attention.

"You would already be against the Nine Pacts after this, and that is a dangerous organization. Legion ranked aren’t even considered that great there, so you can understand. I think it is better to avoid a little trouble now.

And they are a rather good organization. Of course, there is corruption everywhere, so it is your choice, personally it isn’t a bad choice to let them go." Yasmine said. She didn’t want him to turn into someone who just killed anyone mindlessly.
