chapters.title: Chapter 126: Mortal Enemy? Poor Max...
paragraphs: After a pause, Max was the first one to make this suggestion:
"If you lose, I don’t ever want to see you near Fiona, and you will never talk to her again."
Vritra nodded, now showing a slightly unsure expression, then he asked:
"Uh... how about we just forget this thing?"
{Sin Point Gained: Got laughed at +1}

"No no no, Mr. Janitor, we are going to do this whether you like it or not. As a man, you can’t go back on your words, right? Of course, we can cancel it if you don’t consider yourself one." Max had a gloating expression on his face as he spoke.
Vritra sighed, shaking his head helplessly as he replied:
"Fine, since you are insisting so badly, I guess we will just have to do it."
Fiona watched the entire scene in bewilderment. This Vritra was too evil and cunning—she could clearly see how he was playing with Max.

’But it’s just arm wrestling, so it shouldn’t be a problem. At most, Max would end up breaking an arm even if he loses badly, that is no problem as it could be healed easily.’ Fiona thought and decided not to interrupt this match.
But she never would have imagined how wrong she was. Only after hearing Vritra’s next words did she begin to panic.
"Alright, if I lose I will never go near Fiona." Vritra said as he looked at her, a sly grin in his eyes—but to Max, it seemed Vritra was making some tough choice—as he continued:
"But what if you lose?"
{Sin Point Gained: Ridiculed +1}
"Hah, that would never happen, but tell me what it is you want." Max said, but he would never agree to the same condition of not meeting Fiona again.
"You have to get a tattoo on your face. Whatever I want it to be." Vritra said after a few seconds.
{Sin Point Gained: Belittled +1}

"Haha that’s all, fine let’s do it then." Max nodded almost instantly, while Fiona was thinking how to stop this match. What if he made Max have some stupid tattoo—how would they be able to move in public then?
"Uhm..." Fiona tried to speak, but Max felt quite bad by her doubt in him. In an unhappy tone he asked:
"What? Do you want me to cancel this challenge because you think I am weaker than him?"
"Yes— I mean, no, that’s not what I meant, but there is really no need for this—" Fiona tried to change his mind, but as always, the bully Max was hot-headed.
"It might not be for you, but it is for me."
Max then looked back at Vritra, and with a ferocious expression he said:
"Let’s start."
Vritra and Max soon explained their challenge to the guards in charge of overseeing their training, who rolled their eyes—they still remembered the last challenge, after all.
But all the guards agreed and even called a tattoo artist in advance. They would be acting as the judge for the match and also make sure no one went back on his word.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +54}
Soon, Vritra and Max stood on opposite sides of the table. They leaned forward and placed their right elbows over it, before clasping one another’s hand in a tight lock.
"Max... you can win it." Fiona said with absolutely no optimism in her voice—still, she had to cheer him on.
Max smiled and nodded and turned his gaze to Vritra. Finally, he would be able to get rid of this bug who kept lingering around his girl.
"Start at the count of three." The guard said who stood at their side. Even he knew what the result was going to be, so he had paid the tattoo artist in advance.
One...
Two...
Three!!
Both Vritra and Max applied force as the match began. Max used all his strength and Vritra’s hand actually began to bend backwards, as a wide grin spread across Max’s face.
All the classmates had gathered to watch this match, and many of them cheered for Max while others just enjoyed the break. None of them had a good impression of Vritra.
Vritra’s hand was slowly leaning back. His expression seemed as if he was using a lot of force and his arm was trembling.
{Sin Point Gained: Looked down upon +1}
’Haha, this is it. I knew it!! My strength is definitely higher than his.’ Max exclaimed in his mind.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}

’Huh? Max is actually winning? Could I have been wrong all along? Vritra actually isn’t as strong as I thought—no way. He is definitely playing around, he loves to troll people.’ Fiona instantly came to this realization and looked to the side where the tattoo artist was already preparing his tools.
{Sin Point Gained: Belittled +1}
"You lost!! Hahahaha!!" Max laughed loudly as Vritra’s hand was just a few centimeters away from being smashed into the table.
{Sin Point Gained: Impressed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +1}
’Oh hubby, you really love to give people fake hope only to mercilessly shatter it at once, huh. I love it!!’ Yasmine said, entranced by her husband. He was too evil, too cool.
BANG!!
Suddenly, Max felt he couldn’t push Vritra’s hand any further and then it was him who began to lose. Vritra gave him no time as he smashed Max’s hand into the table.
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +54}
There was silence for a few seconds after the loud sound. Max’s body was twisted sideways as he stared at his hand in shock, and then a voice broke the silence.
"So, what kind of tattoo do I need to create?" It was an old man with a thin beard, he was holding his tool with his shaky hands.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +1}

"I- I lost... how? How is that possible? You must have cheated! All of you saw it!! I was about to defeat him but then he... he—" Max looked around but everyone just looked at him with pity. Even they could tell that he was played around by Vritra.

"Oh electro boy, as a man you can’t go back on your words, right? Of course, you can decide not to follow the bet’s condition... if you don’t consider yourself one. There is no use acting now—just say so if you are a pussy." Vritra threw Max’s words back at him, his lips stretching into a wide smile.
"Damnit... sigh. Fine, I will get the tattoo, but you better not take it too far." Max glanced at Fiona and finally gave in. He couldn’t chicken out in front of the girl he loved.
He walked to the side and sat down on the chair, leaning his head back on the headrest and closed his eyes.
Vritra told the tattoo artist what kind of tattoo he wanted on Max’s face.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}

"What? Is he your mortal enemy or something? I wouldn’t do this to even my enemy... sigh. Tsk tsk, that poor fella... fine, I will do that." The old man shook his head, feeling pity for Max as he held his pen with shaky hands and walked close to him.
Instantly the old man began to make the tattoo as Vritra had instructed.

They would be acting as the judge for the match and also make sure no one went back on his word.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +54}
Soon, Vritra and Max stood on opposite sides of the table.
They leaned forward and placed their right elbows over it, before clasping one another’s hand in a tight lock.
"Max... you can win it." Fiona said with absolutely no optimism in her voice—still, she had to cheer him on.
Max smiled and nodded and turned his gaze to Vritra.
Finally, he would be able to get rid of this bug who kept lingering around his girl.
"Start at the count of three." The guard said who stood at their side.
Even he knew what the result was going to be, so he had paid the tattoo artist in advance.
One...
Two...
Three!!
Both Vritra and Max applied force as the match began.
Max used all his strength and Vritra’s hand actually began to bend backwards, as a wide grin spread across Max’s face.
All the classmates had gathered to watch this match, and many of them cheered for Max while others just enjoyed the break.
None of them had a good impression of Vritra.
Vritra’s hand was slowly leaning back.
His expression seemed as if he was using a lot of force and his arm was trembling.
{Sin Point Gained: Looked down upon +1}
’Haha, this is it.
I knew it!!
My strength is definitely higher than his.’ Max exclaimed in his mind.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
’Huh?
Max is actually winning?
Could I have been wrong all along?
Vritra actually isn’t as strong as I thought—no way.
He is definitely playing around, he loves to troll people.’ Fiona instantly came to this realization and looked to the side where the tattoo artist was already preparing his tools.
{Sin Point Gained: Belittled +1}
"You lost!!
Hahahaha!!" Max laughed loudly as Vritra’s hand was just a few centimeters away from being smashed into the table.
{Sin Point Gained: Impressed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +1}
’Oh hubby, you really love to give people fake hope only to mercilessly shatter it at once, huh.
I love it!!’ Yasmine said, entranced by her husband.
He was too evil, too cool.
BANG!!
Suddenly, Max felt he couldn’t push Vritra’s hand any further and then it was him who began to lose.
Vritra gave him no time as he smashed Max’s hand into the table.
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +54}
There was silence for a few seconds after the loud sound.
Max’s body was twisted sideways as he stared at his hand in shock, and then a voice broke the silence.
"So, what kind of tattoo do I need to create?" It was an old man with a thin beard, he was holding his tool with his shaky hands.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +1}
"I- I lost... how?
How is that possible?
You must have cheated!
All of you saw it!!
I was about to defeat him but then he... he—" Max looked around but everyone just looked at him with pity.
Even they could tell that he was played around by Vritra.
"Oh electro boy, as a man you can’t go back on your words, right?
Of course, you can decide not to follow the bet’s condition... if you don’t consider yourself one.
There is no use acting now—just say so if you are a pussy." Vritra threw Max’s words back at him, his lips stretching into a wide smile.
"Damnit... sigh.
Fine, I will get the tattoo, but you better not take it too far." Max glanced at Fiona and finally gave in.
He couldn’t chicken out in front of the girl he loved.
He walked to the side and sat down on the chair, leaning his head back on the headrest and closed his eyes.
Vritra told the tattoo artist what kind of tattoo he wanted on Max’s face.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
"What?
Is he your mortal enemy or something?
I wouldn’t do this to even my enemy... sigh.
Tsk tsk, that poor fella... fine, I will do that." The old man shook his head, feeling pity for Max as he held his pen with shaky hands and walked close to him.
Instantly the old man began to make the tattoo as Vritra had instructed.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Simp of the Century
paragraphs: The process of drawing the tattoo began immediately, and it didn’t take long to draw a permanent tattoo on his face.
He did groan a few times in slight pain, but he acted as if he felt nothing—acting tough in front of Fiona.

When it was finished, Max opened his eyes and stood up. But wherever he looked, he heard gasps from his classmates and guards. He glanced at Fiona, who stared at his face with wide eyes before turning her gaze away, feeling second-hand embarrassment.
She even wanted to act as if the two didn’t know each other.
Max had a sinking feeling in his heart. He wondered what kind of tattoo he had gotten on his face; now he regretted making that bet with Vritra.
"Here you go. But don’t hate me too much, boy, I was just doing my job." The old man passed a mirror to Max and shook his head with a loud sigh.
Max took the mirror and was first surprised by all the writing on his face. At first, he struggled to read the letters since they appeared inverted, but then his face darkened.
On his forehead was:
-FREE SLAPS ANYWHERE!! NO QUESTIONS ASKED!!-
On his right cheek was:
-1 SILVER, ONE ROUND, NO DISCOUNT, NO REFUND!!-
Along with this line, a shaky arrow pointed towards his mouth.
Then his left cheek:
-PROFESSIONAL, IN BUSINESS EVEN BEFORE BIRTH!!-

Everyone read those lines and felt a bit bad for Max, but many felt satisfied since he used to bully them all back on Earth. But even his haters pitied him. How could he walk around with a face like that? They glanced at Fiona and pitied her even more; questioning in their minds:You like this guy? Seriously?!!
"Wait, but what does that mean? In business even before birth? In his mother’s wom—oh wait!! Shit." A boy spoke out loud and then understood, feeling even more disgusted.

They all looked at Vritra, who had a faint smile on his face, and all of them felt that he was a devil. How could someone think of something so evil? He called his mother a slut through that one line.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +1}
"Y-You asshole, what have you done?" Max shouted as he smashed the mirror to the ground in complete madness. He might not be the most handsome, but he was still proud of his face.
Now it was completely ruined. How could he ever face Fiona with such tattoos?
"Hey, don’t worry, I’m not as heartless as you might think. This tattoo isn’t exactly permanent, and it will disappear on its own after some time," Vritra said in a comforting tone.
"..." Max felt a bit relieved hearing that. If it was just for a short time, then he could just cover it with a mask. After a moment, he asked, "How long exactly before it disappears?"
’Hmmm... Should be around five—no, six years. Yes, only that long. Then you would be a free man.’ Vritra said with a kind, friendly smile.
"You fucking bastard! You are messing with me, aren’t you? Do you want to die that badly?" Max screamed. His eyes had turned bloodshot, but he didn’t know that it was just the beginning.

Just as the conflict was about to escalate, one of the teenagers who had not arrived for practice yet came running toward them. His face had an impatient expression, as if he was unable to digest some great news.
It was Lero, the chatterbox of their class and also the one who keeps tabs on everything—the news delivery guy.
"Hey everyone, I just heard something big. Listen to me, today—" but after arriving in the training area, he paused as his gaze landed on Max, and Lero’s eyes widened in surprise.

"Hey there, Max. Those tattoos, uhm... they look sick on you." Lero said, but seeing everyone’s reaction he asked, "Did I miss something? Well, whatever, I brought a few big news items and they are all hundred percent true."
"Sigh... What is it?" another classmate asked, knowing Lero wouldn’t stop until they had heard him.

"So, so, I heard one of the commanders—the one who led the fourth team into the labyrinth—committed suicide after seeing his house getting destroyed. Strangely, his family and servants were perfectly fine." He finished without pausing, then continued:
"I heard an assassin organization—what was its name again, whatever... All the members of it were found dead today, over a thousand members!!" he continued.

"There are even rumors of a very dangerous creature being seen in the kingdom. Oh right, I almost forgot to mention, the team of four from our class that had gone out for some special experience had finally returned, though I heard Risah died because of an accident."
Everyone was shocked upon hearing this news. They wondered if they were truly safe in this place.
Vritra already knew about the first two parts; only the last one was new for him. Along with Risah and Jack, two more people had gone out for this... special tour.
These two people were from Max’s group.
"Fiona!!" Just then, another loud and familiar voice sounded from the distance, and everyone turned to look.
And it was none other than the greatest simp—Jack, with supposedly the best ability among them.
Fiona was already in a bad mood. She glanced at the overly enthusiastic boy and frowned. She had already made it clear that she had no interest in Jack, but the persistent simp just wouldn’t give up.

Max would have beaten Jack up too if his father wasn’t so rich and Max’s own father wasn’t working in their company. So he allowed Jack to act like that. Max was confident—Fiona would never choose him.

"Did you miss me? I thought of you for each and every single day. But now that I am back, can we spend some time together?" Jack said. He did look handsome, but the way he was acting made him look like a pathetic simp.
"Hmm... another clown joined," Vritra mumbled in a not-so-low voice, so Jack heard it too.
"And who the hell are you?" Jack frowned as he saw Vritra, who looked much more handsome than himself. He already started hating him.
After staring for a few seconds, he asked, "Is that Janit—cough, Vritra? Whoa, you look like that?"
Jack exclaimed, then looked at others and soon his gaze landed on Max. After reading those lines, first he burst out laughing, then he walked forward and gave a hard slap to Max’s face—
Before walking back casually, stunning everyone present there.
"What the fuck do you think you are doing?! How dare you!!" Max felt so angry, but even at this place Jack’s status was above his own.
"Huh? It says on your forehead:free slaps, no questions asked. Why did you even get it if it has no meaning?" Jack asked, still laughing at all that writing.
"..." Max gritted his teeth, feeling humiliated in front of all his classmates—especially Fiona.
But then an evil grin appeared on his face.
Why should he be the only one to suffer this? Isn’t it better to share your pain with others?
"Jack, do you like Fiona?" Max asked as his grin widened.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: The Dice Game
paragraphs: "Jack, do you like Fiona?" Max asked as a grin spread across his face.
"Yes, of course. I love her more than anything." Jack replied proudly, glancing at Fiona as he confessed his love once again.

"Heh, can you prove it? I doubt you love her more than me. Just for Fiona, I challenged Vritra to an arm wrestling match even after knowing I am weaker, putting the bet that he don’t step anywhere near her. So can you do the same?" Max said.

"Hah, is he trying to court my girl?" Jack frowned and glared at Vritra, then he huffed and nodded: "Hmph, do you think I am as weak as you? Fine, let’s do this, and if you lose I don’t want to see you anywhere near her. Do you dare to agree?"

"Well, I would never say no to a challenge." Vritra shrugged as he moved towards the table. All the people shook their heads, but this time they felt that Jack, the strongest of them all, might really win.
"But you will end up with a tattoo on your face if you lose," Vritra added.

"Ha, you think you can defeat me? You don’t even know what kind of dangers I had faced out there. I could beat someone like you with just one of my fingers," Jack said arrogantly. How could he not act tough in front of Fiona, the typical boys’ act tough problem.
Max was the happiest after hearing that. He even began to cheer for Jack loudly. The tattoo artist who had started packing up began to prepare for the second victim.
After around five minutes, Jack stood there with a dead look on his face, and a new tattoo.
Vritra went easy on him and only made him have two short tattoos on his cheek and forehead:
-SLAP HERE, FOR FREE-
-NO HOLES BARRED!!-
"Hahaha Jack you look great. Oh right, I almost forgot..." Max wasted no time as he rushed forward and gave an even harder slap on Jack’s face, bringing the holy hero back to his senses.
And so the two began to fight.
Fiona sighed and shook her head. She felt embarrassed just looking at their faces, wondering how the two are going to walk around in public now, and how could she walk beside Max in the future?
"Enjoying the show?" Suddenly Vritra’s voice sounded from beside her, startling Fiona slightly.

"Of course not. How could you write something like that on Max’s face? How can he even show his face to others now? You promised not to-" Fiona complained, running her fingers through her long red hair.
"Why would I care how others look at him? At least he looks more attractive now, he would turn heads wherever he goes.

Anyway, I want you to fulfil your part of the deal now. I will be waiting in your room for fifteen minutes and if you don’t come then I will just challenge Max again." Vritra’s lips curled into a crescent smile as he spoke.
"N-Now? Can’t we do it some other time?" Fiona said, as her heart began to beat wildly.
"Well that’s your choice to make." Vritra shrugged his shoulder and walked away, leaving her alone with her thoughts.

’Sigh, I am sorry Max, even though I love you so much, but I have to do this to protect you. It is just a small stupid game and it will be over before I know it, so no matter what happens I will still love you.’ Fiona apologized to Max in her mind, feeling guilty and humiliated at this betrayal towards her love.
While Max and Jack were busy fighting one another, Fiona glanced one last time at Max before leaving the training area, feeling a little nervous.
The distance between the training area and the temple wasn’t too far, so she arrived there in less than ten minutes. She headed straight to her room.

’How can he enter my room when I had clearly locked it before leaving? Did he mean he would be waiting outside the room?’ Fiona wondered as she quickly arrived in front of her room which was still locked and Vritra was nowhere in sight.

At first she panicked slightly, thinking that she had taken more than fifteen minutes, but then relaxed after thinking for a moment. She opened the lock and pushed open the door. As she expected, Vritra sat on her bed with his back against the pillow in a comfortable position.
"Oh so you really came, and here I was thinking how I was going to make Max challenge me again," Vritra spoke. He had two dice in his hand, as he kept twirling them between his fingers.
"..." Fiona looked around and then entered hastily, before closing the door behind her; she didn’t want anyone to see the two of them together.

"Just tell me what this special game of yours is," Fiona said, walking close to the bed, trying her best to maintain the poker face. While in her mind she kept apologizing to Max for what might happen.
"Alright, it’s a simple game." Vritra sat straight as he gestured for her to come closer. Fiona climbed on the bed and sat in front of him, waiting for his explanation.
"So there will be three rounds, and in each round we will each roll a dice three times. Which means one round will have three turns, clear?

The one to obtain a higher number would be the winner of that turn and get the chance to make a request to the other person. Of course, that request could only be limited to this game and could not be too extreme.

For example, I won two of the three turns and you won one, then at the end of that round, I can make two requests and you can make one request. Of course, using that request you can just nullify one of my requests too. Do you understand it?"

"..." Fiona remained silent for a few seconds. The explanation was quite easy to understand, so after a few seconds she nodded and asked a question: "Suppose I won two turns and you won one, then I will get two requests, right?"
Vritra nodded calmly. He already knew what her doubt was.
"So if I nullify one of your requests, I will still have one left. Can it be brought to the next round?" Fiona asked hopefully.

After hearing about this game, she saw new hope. Since this was a game of luck and based on the rules, there was still a chance that she would be able to get out of this without actually doing anything ecchi with him.
But a curious and horny part of her brain really wanted to see and feel what he might do to her.
That kiss last time felt so magical and hot—Fiona shook her head to throw out that thought, she really couldn’t control that degenerate part of her.
"No, it could only be used in that round. Of course, if you don’t want to use it, then it will be nullified," Vritra answered.

"I see." Fiona nodded in understanding. It was a pity, but oh well. She would just depend on her high luck to get out of this situation and still remain perfectly pure. She wouldn’t have to feel guilty anymore.
"Let’s start then," Vritra announced.

paragraphs: "Every demon you fight here will have a badge on its chest, the one with the highest number of badges will be the winner in the end." The commander explained as he gazed over the teenagers.

’Sigh, at their age I was busy playing and pranking my teachers. These young fellas... they haven’t even experienced the true despair of this world. They shouldn’t have been called here.’ The commander sighed internally. Only one or two would survive against the demons and the rest would end up dead.
"Is there any doubt?" he asked, and after no one spoke, he gestured for them to move.

Twin brothers went in one direction, Max went to another, while the pair of Tyler and Jace silently followed behind him. Vritra headed in another direction and coincidentally, Fiona seemed to have chosen the same direction as him. She maintained a little distance but stayed close to him.
The guards spread across the place and began to watch over them, ready to take action the moment the need arose.
After ten or so minutes, when Vritra and Fiona had travelled a bit farther, they heard the sound of a demon. It was a snake demon and had the ability to crawl through the ground.
HISSSSSS

It suddenly shot out of the ground and viciously charged towards Fiona, who was taken off guard. Fire rose around her hands as she threw it at the demon, but the fireballs only hit the tail of the snake, which didn’t slow it down much.
But before it could get close to her, Vritra hit the head of the snake with a dust hammer, turning it to minced meat in an instant.
"Kiyaaaaah!" Fiona screamed, as she jumped into his arms like a scared rabbit, clinging to him for her dear life.
"It’s alright, you are safe now." Vritra said as he patted her back lightly.
"Oh... Huff, huff... T-Thank you..." she glanced back and saw that the head of the snake demon had been smashed into the ground.
She separated from him and took a few long breaths, patting her heaving chest. After she calmed down, she began walking slowly, loving his protective presence.
Now that she thought about it, he had always been there to protect her, keeping her safe from any and every danger.

Vritra and Fiona walked side by side slowly in the shade of the trees. There were faint sounds of the wind rustling and the distant sound of demons. Surprisingly, even after several minutes no demon disturbed the two, as they enjoyed each other’s presence.
Vritra had been ignoring the occasional messages that had been popping up. He glanced at them as another message appeared.
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[All stats grow by 1]
[You have obtained 1 Allocation Point.]

It seemed his soul wraiths were hard at work. For him only one day had passed, while for them it should be a little over five days. They were fighting the strongest demons constantly—countless of them—and growing alongside Vritra.
Meanwhile, Fiona had thoughts of her own.

’I wonder how he got so strong. Just what happened in that labyrinth that changed him so much? He only had that dust ability originally... wait, dust, then in that game... don’t tell me?’ Fiona suddenly halted as her thoughts reached a conclusion.
"Uhm, Vritra..." Fiona called out.
"Yes?" Vritra paused and turned to look at her, as the two stood face to face.

"In that special game of yours, did you use your dust ability to control the movements of the dice? Is that how you won the last two rounds?" Fiona spoke. Thinking about it, it made sense. The last two rounds were a bit strange after all.
"Huh? Why would I do that? Do you think I would choose such a low trick?" Vritra shook his head as he took the exact two dice out of his inventory.
"Oh, so you really didn’t?" Fiona looked at him skeptically.
"Yeah, I didn’t. Why would I use that obvious trick?" Vritra rolled his eyes as he passed the dice to her, and Fiona looked at them carefully.
"But I did play a trick." He smirked, and with a snap of his fingers all the dots that represented the numbers on the dice turned into dust before floating away in the wind.
Fiona stared blankly at the two plain-surfaced cubes, her eyes wide with shock.
Then she lightly tapped on his chest, muttering: "You really are such a bad boy."
Vritra caught her wrist and pulled her closer, then he pressed her back against a tree and brought his face close to hers.
"W-What are you doing? We can’t do this here. What if someone sees us?" Fiona whispered as she tilted her head down, feeling shy since people might be watching them right now.

"Don’t worry, no one is watching us. Anyway, there is something important I have to tell you." Vritra said, as he lightly pressed his lips against her soft and moist pink lips before separating after a couple of seconds.
"Tell me what?" Fiona didn’t dodge his kiss as she asked, enjoying the sensation of his lips on hers.
"I am going to leave this kingdom in a couple of days along with my mother." Vritra said, as he looked into her eyes.

"I probably won’t be returning to this kingdom again. Aren’t you happy that you will finally be able to have a good life with the love of your life?" Vritra said as he let go of her hands and took a step back.

"..." Fiona wanted to speak but no words came out of her mouth. How could she feel happy about this? She had just started to realise her first true love—not just a crush, but someone who made her feel happy, protected, excited, and so much more.
Her heart sank at his words and all emotions drained from her face. She watched as Vritra turned and began walking away slowly.

’I would not be able to see him for a very long time... those kisses, hugs... all that will be gone too.’ Fiona’s mind rolled as she realised that she was falling deeper for him from the moment he saved her the first time.
She had tried not to accept it till now, but the pain in her chest made her realise that she had already fallen hard for him.

She gulped with difficulty, and her feet moved on their own. She didn’t want him to disappear from her sight or her life. At first slowly, and then she ran behind him, hugging him from behind as tightly as she could.
"C-Can I come with you?" Fiona asked. From her voice it seemed she really was about to cry.
"..." Vritra remained silent for a few seconds, and that silence seemed to make Fiona feel sinking pain.
Some distance away in the forest, Tyler and Jace, who had been silently following behind Max, glanced at each other and could see the fear and reluctance in each other’s eyes.
It was time to start the final part of their plan—something neither of them wanted to do.

"T- This—NO, Fiona!! What are you doing? I love you so much, h- how can you do this to me?" Max fell to his knees and cried loudly. This was the one person he didn’t want to be separated from.

He felt broken as unimaginable pain shot through his heart. He wanted to beg, explain, and so much more, but now nothing held any value to the girl of his dreams.
Vritra’s revenge was complete... on the emotional level. And after this, Max would be broken completely, before he gradually dies.

After that incident, Fiona threw the matter out of her head. She didn’t want to give even a tiny space of her mind to that nasty and disgusting person. Instead, she looked at Vritra’s handsome face and felt so happy that because of him she was able to avoid a life of shame and misery with Max.
Vritra and Fiona just walked around the forest and didn’t fight a single demon. After several hours, when it was time to end the training, the two walked back towards the meeting point.
Everyone had already gathered there. Max couldn’t be seen; it seemed he was already seated in one of the carriages.
"What a pity, we didn’t get to collect any badges." Fiona shook her head and sighed, finding it strange that after the first demon, not a single one came towards them to attack.
"Huh? What do you mean? We did collect quite a lot of badges." Vritra smiled as he walked towards the table and poured out more than thirty badges before saying:
"These demons were hunted by Fiona."
"When did you even kill them? And why are you giving my name? You should take the reward for it." Fiona said in surprise.

"Don’t worry, I have something planned." Vritra said with a smile. He didn’t really need those rewards. He had already emptied the biggest treasury of the king after all. Collecting these badges had a different reason.
"..." Fiona smiled and didn’t reject. Why would she reject a gift from her man? She felt cared for as he took her hand and the two walked towards an empty carriage.
With over thirty badges, Fiona easily won the challenge. After arriving back, everyone had gathered in front of the castle where King Aldric came to meet and encourage them.
Then he gave a treasure to Fiona—it was a pair of earrings with some special effects.
Meanwhile, Vritra’s gaze was fixed on the king’s fingers. He was wearing eight rings, one on each of his fingers, and all of them looked like treasures.
The king was in a great mood for some reason, as if he had just returned after making the biggest deal of his life—but Vritra wasn’t much concerned about that.
Vritra wasted no time as he used the appraisal skill but...
[Appraisal failed.]

He tried again, but the same message popped up. It seemed some object on the king’s body was obstructing his skill. He clicked his tongue in frustration as his plan to check whether the rumor was true had failed.

’Looks like I can only steal—borrow—that one-time-use ring from the king to check if it’s real or not.’ Vritra thought, as he began to plan the theft—act of borrowing—only without letting the other side know.
"Hehe, do I look good in them?" Fiona asked as she pushed her hair behind her ear and showed him the new earrings.

"Anything would look good on you." Vritra said as he smiled and caressed her cheek. The whole thing of getting Fiona might have been filled with cunning, but now that she was his woman, he would take the best care of her and protect her forever.

"Hehe, thank you..." Fiona felt her heart melt with sweetness. She just wanted to spend each and every second of her time with him. They had gotten into a relationship just a few hours ago and she already felt such a strong bond with him.

"Tsk tsk, flirting right in front of your wife? Sigh, where is this world heading towards? There is no virtue and trust left anymore. Hehe." Yasmine giggled, always there for him with her playful teasing.
Vritra: "..."
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
As the night fell and the sky turned dark, the great thief Sir Vritra disappeared from the world. Vanessa had already fallen asleep, as he flew out of his room.

A big part of the castle had already been repaired after it was destroyed because of Vritra’s attack. The guards were hard at work—there had been chaos in the Dunshire Kingdom after all—so more than double the normal number of guards had been placed there to protect the king.
None of them could detect Vritra as he headed directly towards the king’s room. While flying, he wondered—

"Now that I think about it, I haven’t seen any family members of the king. No wives, no concubines, or any children. I wonder what might be the reason." He mumbled, but in the fourth dimension, no one could hear him.
"We can worry about that later, let’s finish this task first." Yasmine reminded him. For some reason, her instincts were telling her that something big—very big—would be taking place very soon.
Soon Vritra arrived near Aldric’s room. He planned to scan the room from outside first before heading in, to make sure there weren’t any traps or strong people to protect him in there.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Under the bed?
paragraphs: [Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra used the third eye as he scanned the king’s room from outside, while Yasmine was also checking up if it was safe to go inside. After a few seconds, they both didn’t find any kind of problem.
"I think it is fine to go inside now. I can only sense the presence of a single person in there," Yasmine said.
Vritra nodded as he deactivated the Nether Eye. He couldn’t see completely through the darkness; the sight was a bit blurry, probably because of some treasure.
"It being so empty just makes me a bit nervous. Why isn’t there any guard or something there?" Vritra wondered out loud. Even though he had killed two of them, there should be more, right?

Just then, he noticed that at the door, a guard from one of the borders of the kingdom had arrived with important news related to demons. But the people guarding the door just wouldn’t let him enter, saying:
"For one day the king can’t meet anyone. He had ordered us to not let anyone inside, no matter how serious the matter is. He is in some kind of meditative state."

"One of our borders was breached by the demons! I have to tell the king about this, or the nasty demons would be upon us all in no time. This kingdom is in danger—just let me enter," the guard from the border said, but he wasn’t allowed to enter in the end.
Vritra found it a bit strange. He had seen the king during the day, and he was in such great mood; he wondered what all of this was about after all.
"Well, let’s just go inside, borrow the ring and leave," Vritra thought as he took a deep breath and passed through the room’s wall, putting a mask over his face—just in case.

After entering the room, he came out of the Fourth Dimension and landed softly on the floor. Without wasting a moment, he looked around once again and saw that the room was filled with treasures and jewels.
He moved closer to the bed, which was surrounded by a flowing canopy, suspended from above, forming a delicate barrier of fabric.
It looked like the royal room from dramas. Vritra and Yasmine had sensed that the king—who was the only person in the room—should be on the bed.
He slowly pushed aside the silky cloth and narrowed his eyes as he focused in the darkness. His passive skill seemed to be having a hard time right now.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Startled +1}
As his vision adjusted better, Vritra was surprised to see that the bed was completely empty. That shouldn’t have been the case.
The bad feeling in his heart grew as he looked around, and soon his gaze landed on a particular thing hanging over the wall.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}
’W-What the fuck?!!’ Vritra cursed and took a step back. Sweat appeared on his forehead as a single drop slid across his face and fell to the floor.
DRIP
There on the wall was the corpse of King Aldric, hung with a large sword piercing through his chest—pinning him to the wall.

There wasn’t a drop of blood leaking, and the king’s body had absolutely no presence. When scanning the room earlier, both Yasmine and Vritra believed it to be nothing more than some antique hanging on the wall.
Aldric’s body was incredibly thin, as if every drop of blood had been sucked out of his body, and he had been dead for several years.
’Wait, if the king’s body had no presence, then who was it that we had sensed?’ Vritra’s heartbeat increased slightly as he gasped in bewilderment.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Startled +1}
"Hurry up and just take the ring, let’s get out of here immediately," Yasmine reminded him in a hurry.

Whoever was the other person in the room, they were definitely hiding under the bed. Vritra jumped onto the bed in haste, swallowing his saliva as he activated the Fourth Dimension but kept only his hands outside—his fingers up to the wrist.

He began to take off the rings from the king, but it was like they were stuck on his bones. He exerted a bit more strength and then... Vritra accidentally pulled off the entire finger along with the ring.
He was surprised, but soon he went towards the second ring and again, it was stuck. He pulled hard and only tore off another finger of his hand.
After that, Vritra just collected all eight of the fingers and threw them into his inventory. Then even his hands disappeared as he ran out of the room at full speed.
After flying for a few seconds and arriving some distance away from the castle, Vritra let out a long breath that he had been holding unconsciously.
That was such a strange situation. Vritra had a feeling that he had accidentally been caught in some kind of conspiracy.
"What the hell was that? Who killed the king?" Vritra finally let out all his shock as he shouted, while still in his disappearing state.
"I think there is a big conspiracy going on behind the scenes. First the Nine Pacts, then the demons... something much bigger is about to happen here," Yasmine said in a solemn tone.

"I think there is a high chance that the person who killed the king wasn’t from the Nine Pacts, not even a demon. Then does that mean there is a third power at play here?" Vritra pondered to himself as he continued.
"Maybe the killer had some way to know that we were scanning the room, and that is why he hid himself.
I don’t think he was there to steal anything, and with how hard he was trying to hide, it must be that shifting-the-blame game. Fuck, how is my luck so bad?

That bastard—hoo, we shouldn’t curse the dead. Aldric looked so jolly during the day, and he was killed the same night? And I ended up right at the crime scene, just after the crime was committed." Vritra felt frustrated at his shitty luck.
But at least he had succeeded in his mission, though the situation had just become extremely dangerous.
"I think the same too. Nine Pacts could easily control the king, and the demons have a deal with the Nine Pacts, so I doubt those two would kill him. Then yeah, someone is trying to stir big trouble.
Killing a king is a very big matter, even for a small kingdom like that. Many strong people would be coming to this place to investigate,"
Yasmine added, wondering how her hubby always managed to find trouble even if he could have just happily stayed in his room, in his mother’s comforting and warm embrace.

"Whatever, I will think about it later. We will have to leave this kingdom as soon as tomorrow. Damnit!!" Vritra cursed again, and then decided to check if all this trouble actually bore him some benefit or not.
He took out the eight fingers of the king. They were very skinny, and the skin was stuck to the ring’s body. There was absolutely no blood in any of the fingers.
Vritra instantly got to work as he began to separate the fingers and the rings.

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Luck Overload
paragraphs: Within seconds, he threw away all the fingers and now had eight rings in his hands. Taking a deep breath and calming his wildly beating heart, Vritra decided to check them all one by one with his appraisal skill.
[Appraisal Activated.]
[Azar Ring of Protection](Broken)
[Description]:Activates a protective barrier in life-threatening situations.

Vritra read one ring’s description after another, and he was surprised that despite having all kinds of treasures, the king had died so easily and without a noise. The person who had murdered him must be very strong—probably even a legion-ranked.
And finally...
[Ring of Genesis’s Blessing]
[Description]:One-time-use item. Upon usage, the luck of the user would increase by thirty times for ten seconds.

"Oh!! So the rumors were true after all. Aldric did possess a treasure that could momentarily increase a person’s luck, but the time is too short." Vritra calculated in his mind and came to the conclusion that in ten seconds, he could rotate the wheel over ten times.
And the chances of him getting a reward should also increase quite a bit because of this great treasure.
"I guess beggars can’t be choosers. Well, we have to be happy with what we got," Vritra mumbled to himself. This was still a wonderful object.
First, he checked the total Sin Points available now.
{Sin Points: 2,892,163}
Without wasting any time, he purchased ten keys and spent exactly one hundred thousand points. It was better to use it as soon as possible—who knows what kind of danger he might encounter next.
He placed all the other rings into his inventory and wore the Genesis’s Blessing. He took a long breath and looked around himself to find a better location to rotate the Gacha.
{Sin Points: 2,792,163}
(Sin Keys available: 10)
Vritra flew a bit further away and stopped at the entrance of the forest. There were no people around, at least for a few hundred meters.
"Good luck," Yasmine said before going silent. She too felt a bit anxious; if he could draw a couple of good skills, then his strength would greatly increase instantly.
Vritra got ready. The moment he used the ring, he would have to use all the keys simultaneously. He hoped to get at least one good thing from this drawing—he would just be happy if he could get one.
[Used Ring of Genesis’s Blessing.]
[Your luck has increased by thirty times for ten seconds.]
Vritra moved as fast as he could, inserting one key after another into the Divine Sin Wheel. Messages popped in front of him, but he ignored them all and did his best not to waste even a second.
[Used 10 Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 0]
Exactly after the ten seconds had passed, the ring faded into tiny pieces of energy and disappeared completely, and Vritra’s luck returned to normal.
He took several long breaths to calm himself, and finally decided to see the ten messages that had popped consecutively.
He glanced uninterestedly towards the first message.
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
"Damnit," Vritra cursed and then said, "Yasmine, you read the messages and tell me if there is anything good. My luck can’t be that shit, right?"
Vritra ignored the nine remaining messages and showed them to Yasmine, his heartbeat increasing slightly. But because ofSerene Mindhe could still remain calm.
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +1}
"WOAHHH!!" In the next moment, Yasmine let out a loud surprised gasp. Vritra released his long breath, shaking his head in disappointment.

"So I am a failure. Even with that ring, my luck’s so shitty that I drew nothing? Even you are shocked by that shitty luck, right?" Vritra drowned in self-pity as he looked at the starry sky, which was covered by clouds.
"My luck’s so bad, I can’t even see the stars. My luck’s so bad, I—" Vritra continued like a broken poet, writing poems about the tragedies of his life.
Yasmine rolled her eyes, laughing at his behavior before she muttered, "Don’t be so dramatic, just look at the messages."
Finally, with his shoulders drooped, Vritra looked at the nine messages.
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{You have acquired the Hybrid skill—}

Vritra paused reading in the middle, as a big smile got plastered across his face. The wordHybridinstantly brought joy to him, even making him forget about the conspiracy he might have already become a part of.
Just look at ’Shift’—that is a terrifying skill, so he was super happy to obtain one. Even if it was the only skill he got, he wouldn’t complain anymore.
Maintaining the big smile, he continued to read.
{You have acquired the Hybrid skill Intra Shuffle!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{You have acquired Passive Skill Elegy Parasite!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{You have acquired the Potion: Pulse Reversal!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{Better Luck Next Time!!}
{You have acquired the Active Skill SUCK! SUCK! SUCK!}
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}
"F-Four rewards?!!" Vritra almost dropped from the sky, but this time not because of trauma—but because of joy.
"..." With wide eyes, he stared at the screen, then rubbed his eyes and looked again. Those rewards remained there. It really wasn’t a dream.

"Thank you, King Aldric. At least after your death, you are atoning for your sins. This was a great parting gift from you to me," Vritra said, and he finally forgave the king. How could he not when he had received such great rewards?
"Don’t waste any time, let’s see what these things are," Yasmine said impatiently, her curiosity and excitement just as high as his.
Vritra smiled from ear to ear and nodded. He glanced over the rewards and decided to start with the potion, since it must be a one-time-use item, so he had to be careful with this thing.
[Pulse Reversal]
[Description]:A potion that could bring a corpse back from the dead within three days of dying.

The description was pretty clear and easy to understand, and Vritra was surprised by its effect. It was a miraculous potion—a highest-grade treasure. Bringing a dead person back to life—isn’t it something only the gods can do?

"..." Vritra read the short description several times and felt his heart leap with joy. A god-tier reward indeed. He felt so happy that he had a strong urge to test it upon himself right there and then—but he calmed his overly excited heart and pulled out the potion from his inventory.
It was stored in a glass bottle the size of a palm. The potion was red in colour and seemed to be sparkling even in the darkness of the night.
"Oh, I had heard about such a potion, but it was more like a myth since creating it is near impossible. What a great thing..." Yasmine mumbled in awe. Just this one thing was worth a lot of trouble.

Vritra placed it back into his inventory, worried that it might accidentally slip from his hands in the excitement. He would have to hang himself on a crucifix and nail his arms and feet if that were to actually happen.
"Now, let’s see what we have got here." Vritra rubbed his palms together in excitement and looked at his new skills.

[Appraisal Activated.]
[Azar Ring of Protection](Broken)
[Description]:Activates a protective barrier in life-threatening situations.
Vritra read one ring’s description after another, and he was surprised that despite having all kinds of treasures, the king had died so easily and without a noise.
The person who had murdered him must be very strong—probably even a legion-ranked.
And finally...
[Ring of Genesis’s Blessing]
[Description]:One-time-use item.

{Sin Points: 2,892,163}

It was better to use it as soon as possible—who knows what kind of danger he might encounter next.

{Sin Points: 2,792,163}
(Sin Keys available: 10)
Vritra flew a bit further away and stopped at the entrance of the forest.
There were no people around, at least for a few hundred meters.
"Good luck," Yasmine said before going silent.
She too felt a bit anxious; if he could draw a couple of good skills, then his strength would greatly increase instantly.
Vritra got ready.
The moment he used the ring, he would have to use all the keys simultaneously.

[Your luck has increased by thirty times for ten seconds.]

My luck can’t be that shit, right?"

But because ofSerene Mindhe could still remain calm.

Vritra released his long breath, shaking his head in disappointment.
"So I am a failure.
Even with that ring, my luck’s so shitty that I drew nothing?
Even you are shocked by that shitty luck, right?" Vritra drowned in self-pity as he looked at the starry sky, which was covered by clouds.

{Better Luck Next Time!!}

{Better Luck Next Time!!}

SUCK!}

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Voromir Zuke
paragraphs: Inside the forest, close to the labyrinth.

Three people floated in the air, hiding behind the clouds, as they gazed down at the resting place of their lord. All three of them were distinct in looks but wore similar worn-out leather clothes, as if they dearly cherished those clothes.
The three demons were named Rothellis, Silquor, and Morvik.
They served under the demon lord Voromir Zuke, the demon lord that had been slain quite some time ago by that wretched and overly ambitious Mythic Halo.

The three demon generals had lost so many from their army, their resources, fort, and everything had long been taken away by other demon lords. The demon world is much more wretched than the humans’, or so the three demon generals believed.
They hid themselves from the world for a long time and searched for any remnants of their lord, and finally, their search bore fruit, as they found Voromir Zuke’s resting place.
Even though he had been killed a long time ago, his energy, blood, and traces of soul and will still lingered in that labyrinth.

And that was more than enough to resurrect him. But it was the rebirth of a demon lord. It needed a large amount of time, sacrifices, and preparations. The three demon generals even made deals with the lowly humans just for the sake of their lord.

But it won’t be long before they succeed in their task. And this kingdom was just the perfect place for that. All the resources and countless lives would be lost, but what does it matter if the goal is achieved—even if the entire kingdom becomes barren?
Rothellis stood tall in the air. His body was burly with two curved horns over his head. His skin was greyish, and just by seeing him, anyone would think he is a brute who focuses on strength.
His clothes seemed to be barely holding his large muscles. His height was over eight feet, and he looked like a little giant.
With a ferocious expression on his face, he looked as if he was just ready to fight, waiting for someone’s invitation.
Silquor was scrawny and old, almost looking as if he was barely holding onto life. Upon seeing him, anyone would think that the swaying winds might blow him away.
His clothes hung loosely to his body. His skin was dark yellow and looked shriveled. He held onto a walking stick and kept shaking.

The last, Morvik, wore completely white clothes from the top of his head to his feet. Not even his pupils were exposed out of those white clothes. It was hard to guess even his height from seeing him, but above those clean white cloth, he too wore the same old clothes as the other two demon generals.
The strength of the three demon generals was off the charts—they could crush Bob and Bobby in an instant. They had worked really hard and had never been this close to their goal.
The three stared at the labyrinth and discussed in calm yet excited voices.
"The energy of our lord seems to have weakened quite a bit from the last time we were here," Rothellis spoke with his fists clenched behind his back.

"These puny humans dare to use the energy, flesh, and blood of our lord for their growth. All of them will have to pay for this. None of them could escape the punishment, and once our lord returns, we will be able to rise once again," Silquor spoke, his voice coming out slightly trembling.

"Let’s deal with them later. The most important matter right now is to bring our lord back. Have you kept it safely?" Morvik’s voice was more like a loud whisper; his voice sounded like the hissing of a snake.
"Yeah, this was the hardest object to obtain. We had to go through so much trouble to obtain this." Silquor took out a black box from a cube, which is called Glyph in this world.
He opened the lid of the box and an extremely terrifying aura burst out of the box, making even the demon generals shiver. This was the core of a demon lord.
Someone who stands at the pinnacle under the gods, the demon lord could kill the generals within moments—their power was just that great.

The three generals knelt in the air as they showed respect to the Energy Core of their lord. The energy core glowed with a dark bluish colour. It was spherical and had a bit over two centimetres in diameter.
That small thing possessed a vast amount of energy. Then they praised their lord with utter respect:
"We greet our lord. The Zuke shall live forever."the three shouted.

"Hmph, if it wasn’t for that wretched Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo, our lord wouldn’t have died. He was one of the strongest under the command of one of the demon gods," Rothellis said, his voice full of arrogance. His bull-like face was scrunched up as he cursed the demons who took advantage of their lord’s death.

"But our lord was wise enough to prepare this second core that was just as great as his original core—if not more. I believe after the resurrection, his strength will be even higher," Silquor muttered as he looked at the spherical core, which was a great treasure even for a demon lord.
Voromir Zuke had prepared the essence core in advance, but getting it and bringing it here safely had been anything but easy. It took them several years just to come to this final step.

"Let’s not waste any time and start with the rituals. It will take over a week for our lord to return. If we delay, unseen events might lead to trouble. Those cultist bastards have been lurking around this kingdom, following us and sniffing like the damn dogs they are," Rothellis cursed.

"The Nine Pacts have been asking us to take care of someone for them. These pesky bugs think just because we made a deal, they can control us. Just a little longer and they will remember the terror of our lord," Morvik said, his voice a loud whisper.

"I sense some unusual activity in the labyrinth. Do you think that wretched Mythic Halo could still be alive?" Rothellis muttered as he sensed the strange but weak fluctuations coming from the deepest parts of the labyrinth.
"Tsk, I doubt it could have survived that barrage of attacks. And even if it did somehow, seeing how it is still hiding despite its proud and ambitious behaviour, then it must be seriously injured.
That would be just perfect— as our lord forces the 3rd ranked Mythic Halo to submit," Silquor said out loud as the three generals laughed loudly at the great future that lay ahead of them.
They were still kneeling under the dangerous aura that reminded them of their lord. It was almost like he was standing in front of them, stronger than ever.
"Alright, let’s start." The three nodded at one another as they stood up and prepared to leave.
WHOOSH
Right at that moment, a strong wind swept across the entire forest, but it held no energy and seemed more as if a huge fan had been swung across the forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Trash skill?
paragraphs: WHOOSH

Just then, a strong wind swept across the entire forest. Nothing seemed wrong about it, so the three generals didn’t react instantly— but then they felt the energies in their bodies being sucked out just a tiny bit.
It surprised the three; they wondered what kind of supernatural phenomenon was taking place, but more important than their curiosity was the rebirth of their lord.
But then...
Chhiiiiiuuuuuuuuuu...

Like a bullet, the glowing Essence Core flew away at lightning speed. The changes were so fast that even demon generals with immense strength couldn’t understand what happened until a fraction of a second had passed.

The speed at which the core had flown away was so fast that they found it hard to even follow it with their gazes. After being frozen for less than a second, the three generals reacted quickly as they shouted:
"Lorrrddddddddd!!"
"Our lord got snatched, c-catch him. Oh no!!"

"Idiots, get moving," Morvik cursed his two idiotic teammates as he shot forward at full speed. It was either that cult or maybe even the Nine Pacts who might have guessed their motive for coming to this kingdom.
The other two also reacted instantly as deadly energy burst out of their bodies. They followed after Morvik and in an instant arrived where they sensed the Essence Core.
But all of a sudden, its presence seemed to have diminished. The three could sense that there had definitely been a person in this space, but he had moved just as they had arrived.
"Find the Essence Core. It could not have been taken too far just yet. We can’t lose it," Thaddeus muttered, his body releasing a demonic aura.
The three demons were utterly enraged. Whoever could be behind this theft— they would tear him apart with their own hands.
Just then, they sensed the energy burst from the Essence Core. The three said no word as they shot toward that location, leaving behind loud explosive noises.
This might just be the last chance for them to catch the thief and get back the Essence Core— the chance to bring back Voromir.

"Whoever it is, they are trying to absorb the Essence Core and integrate with it right away. Either that person didn’t have any other choice, or he is confident enough— or maybe there is some accident on the other side," Morvik spoke, voicing the most probable possibilities.

"Hah! This was a mistake, and I will torture the cursed thief to the extreme. He thinks he could just take away our lord’s Essence Core? And even integrate with it in such a short time while three demon generals are following behind him?" Silquor shouted, his eyes burning with rage.
"I can sense the thief up ahead. Let’s strike him first and then ask."
The three generals got ready with their attacks as they closed in on the thief, their power enough to obliterate him.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
WHOOOOOOOOOSH!!
BAAANNNNGGGGGG!!
All three attacks exploded at the same time, hitting the target and making it burst into pieces.
[Intra Shuffle]

[Skill Description]:This skill allows the user to rearrange the internal structure of their body to avoid fatal damage. Under certain limits, the body can be distorted or reshaped according to the user’s imagination— redirecting organs, shifting bones, or compressing tissue to protect vital areas. It can activate automatically in response to life-threatening injuries, or be manually triggered when needed.
Vritra read the skill description with delight. Although this skill didn’t increase his strength like many other skills, it was purely for survival.

What better tactic could there be in a fight than letting the opponent believe they’ve won after piercing your head— only to find out the brain had been relocated, and it was just a piece of flesh that got hit?
"Dang, anything that comes out from that wheel couldn’t be simple. This is magnificent."
Vritra’s smile widened even further. This would be greatly effective in fights, especially when he was fighting against stronger opponents.
Instantly, he decided to give this skill a try and familiarise himself with it. Closing his eyes, Vritra scanned his body, looking at every bone and organ. He had to be careful when using it, too.
Otherwise, he might end up hurting himself if he placed the organs in the wrong way or place.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Vritra’s organs shifted in an instant. It felt quite strange at first as he shifted his heart to the right side. He did a few more experiments and quickly got used to it.
It seemed using it might not be as hard as he had imagined. His body would just twist and distort automatically even if he placed his organs in a dangerous location.
It was a Hybrid skill, after all.
"That’s great. I could already imagine the countless ways this skill could save your life in the future," Yasmine said, as the couple nodded their heads in satisfaction.
"Time to see the next skill. Both the previous rewards were top-notch—much better than anything I could have asked for," Vritra mumbled as he gazed at his next skill.
[Elegy Parasite]
[Description]:A dormant parasite that hates dying more than anything. The parasite awakens automatically when health goes lower than 1%.

Consumes life force to stay alive and increases survival instinct over the span of the battle. It won’t go back to slumber until either the threat has disappeared or the complete life force is devoured.
Vritra read the description twice and only felt that this skill, which awakens in extremely dangerous situations, was actually quite dangerous.
Less than 1% health would mean that he would be about to die. He wasn’t sure how this skill would work—and Vritra didn’t want to find that out either.
Since this was a passive skill, it would work on its own. But if it consumed his life force after activation, wouldn’t it just bring him even closer to death?

Vritra knew that this skill must be great as well, but right now, he couldn’t understand how effective it would be when it is actually needed. So he decided to ignore it for now. Anyway, this was a skill related to his survival as well.

BothIntra ShuffleandElegy Parasitewere mainly focused on survival in dangerous situations, and since both of them could be triggered on their own in the face of danger, he didn’t really have to put much focus on them.
Finally, his gaze landed on the final and strangest skill. Vritra’s eyebrows rose as he read its name.
He wondered if, for the first time, even the Divine Sin Wheel had thrown out a trash skill.

But maintaining his faith in this godly cheat that had always greatly benefitted him, he began to read its description in great hope. Maybe it was just the name that was not as good as the others—it still might have a great effect.
[SUCK! SUCK! SUCK!]
[Skill Description]:What’s there to understand, just start- SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Anything that is energy, is meant to suck and swallow.
Vritra’s lips stretched in a thin line as he read that short and unclear description. It seemed this really might be the first trash reward he had obtained from this golden wheel.

[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Vritra’s organs shifted in an instant.
It felt quite strange at first as he shifted his heart to the right side.
He did a few more experiments and quickly got used to it.
It seemed using it might not be as hard as he had imagined.
His body would just twist and distort automatically even if he placed his organs in a dangerous location.
It was a Hybrid skill, after all.
"That’s great.
I could already imagine the countless ways this skill could save your life in the future," Yasmine said, as the couple nodded their heads in satisfaction.
"Time to see the next skill.
Both the previous rewards were top-notch—much better than anything I could have asked for," Vritra mumbled as he gazed at his next skill.
[Elegy Parasite]
[Description]:A dormant parasite that hates dying more than anything.
The parasite awakens automatically when health goes lower than 1%.
Consumes life force to stay alive and increases survival instinct over the span of the battle.
It won’t go back to slumber until either the threat has disappeared or the complete life force is devoured.
Vritra read the description twice and only felt that this skill, which awakens in extremely dangerous situations, was actually quite dangerous.
Less than 1% health would mean that he would be about to die.
He wasn’t sure how this skill would work—and Vritra didn’t want to find that out either.
Since this was a passive skill, it would work on its own.
But if it consumed his life force after activation, wouldn’t it just bring him even closer to death?
Vritra knew that this skill must be great as well, but right now, he couldn’t understand how effective it would be when it is actually needed.
So he decided to ignore it for now.
Anyway, this was a skill related to his survival as well.

BothIntra ShuffleandElegy Parasitewere mainly focused on survival in dangerous situations, and since both of them could be triggered on their own in the face of danger, he didn’t really have to put much focus on them.
Finally, his gaze landed on the final and strangest skill.
Vritra’s eyebrows rose as he read its name.
He wondered if, for the first time, even the Divine Sin Wheel had thrown out a trash skill.
But maintaining his faith in this godly cheat that had always greatly benefitted him, he began to read its description in great hope.
Maybe it was just the name that was not as good as the others—it still might have a great effect.
[SUCK!
SUCK!
SUCK!]
[Skill Description]:What’s there to understand, just start- SUCK!
SUCK!
SUCK!
Anything that is energy, is meant to suck and swallow.
Vritra’s lips stretched in a thin line as he read that short and unclear description.
It seemed this really might be the first trash reward he had obtained from this golden wheel.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Demon in hiding?
paragraphs: "Wifey, do you understand anything from the description?" Vritra asked as he tapped on his chin.

"I don’t understand either. Does this thing allow you to absorb energy directly or something? Like absorbing energy directly from the air to refill your empty mana reserves?" Yasmine shared her thoughts.
"I guess we won’t know if it is good or bad until I give it a try. I just hope it isn’t too bad." Vritra looked at his surroundings and decided to move further away from there.
He flew slightly deeper into the forest. What if this skill acted the same way as he thought? Wouldn’t he accidentally end up absorbing the life force of people around him and killing them?
After moving far enough, he came out of his disappearing state, since in the fourth dimension he couldn’t affect his surroundings in any way, so this strange skill most probably wouldn’t work.
"Alright, let’s give it a try." Vritra released a long breath as he mentally prepared himself for this. He wasn’t sure exactly what would happen, so he was about excited and anxious.
[SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Activated.]
Just as the skill activated, Vritra felt as if his mouth had turned into an extremely strong vacuum cleaner, as energy from all sides began to pull at a rapid speed into his body.

Vritra was surprised at first. It was just as he thought; just after activating the skill, he would be able to suck the energy from the environment and maybe even the energy from the enemy’s body, refilling his own energy reserves.

Though it might not be powerful enough to suck people’s life force, Vritra still felt that this was a great skill. He would never need to use mana potions again, and he would never be short on energy.
Even if the battle drew on for a long time, he could just refill while the enemy got weaker— even the enemy’s energy would be sucked dry.
He would be able to use the strongest move again and again on top of that.
Vritra’s mouth was opened wide in an O shape. A gust of wind was released when the skill was activated, though it didn’t pull anything but energy.
Indeed, the Divine Sin Wheel could never give out a shitty skill. Even if the name was strange, it was a great skill that increased his battle prowess instantly.
Since the experiment was successful and his energy reserve became full to the brim, Vritra was about to deactivate the skill for now, feeling quite satisfied with the result.

But just then, a strong wave of demonic energy entered his body, startling him a bit. At first, he panicked, but then all the demonic energy got swallowed hungrily by the essence core in his body. It too got filled to the brim within moments and actually began to grow.

’Oh, where did this demonic energy come from? Maybe it is from the labyrinth?’ Vritra wondered and decided to take even more. The Evil-Veyll God Essence was already so strong—if it could grow further, then his attack power would greatly increase.

Vritra used all his might and pushedSUCK! SUCK! SUCK!to its limit as an even stronger wave of air swept across the forest. Vritra indeed felt more of that strong demonic energy entering his body, but in the next moment...
GULP

Something flew at lightning speed in his direction, and before he knew it, it was sucked into his mouth and got stuck in his throat. Vritra swallowed unconsciously before getting frozen by confusion and bewilderment.
Yes, both Yasmine and Vritra froze the moment he swallowed that unknown item.
In the next instant, Yasmine was the first to react; she sensed immediately what it was exactly that her trouble-magnet husband had just swallowed.
"F- Fuck!! SPIT IT OUT IMMEDIATELY!!" she spoke with urgency before teleporting him to a faraway location when she sensed some really dangerous presence approaching them.
Right now, she couldn’t even defeat the BOB, a Myriad creature, so how could she challenge the demon generals who had levels of several thousand?

She teleported him to a random location. Vritra was baffled. Not because of the sudden teleportation or the strange sensation that was growing in his body, nor because of the danger he had just sensed or the object he had just swallowed, but... because Yasmine cursed for the first time.
And what does that mean?
The situation was truly fucked.
{Sin Point Gained: Chased +3}
Finally, Vritra came to his senses. He coughed hard and tried to spit out the round object, but to no avail—it had already travelled down into his body and got stuck there somehow.
"W- What was that?" Vritra asked, as the strange sensation grew rapidly within his body.

"Damnit, how could you just attract troubles from all sides, hubby? Weren’t you summoned here by a goddess? Why do you keep getting demonic things into your body? Are you sure you are not a demon in hiding? Or do you have some kind of fetish related to demons?

First that Demon God energy and traces of the 2nd ranked demonic halo, that was fine. Even eating demonic meat and drinking demonic blood was fine, but why did you suddenly raise your standard and aim directly for the Essence Core of a Demon Lord? W- We are doomed!!" Yasmine was just as panicked, she spurted her frustration before getting to work.
But sensing the current situation, they both knew that before crying over the spilled milk, they had to escape from their dangerous pursuers and somehow also deal with the essence core.
Finally, his puny body couldn’t hold in the energy of the demon lord. It spread across his body rapidly and swallowed him completely from the inside.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
BOOM!!
His hand was the first to explode, but Vritra had sensed the danger in advance. So using his new hybrid skill, he made his body distort and shifted his bones and most of his flesh away just in time.
What exploded was only part of his flesh and skin, but it was still a little painful. And the energy was consuming his entire body. Soon, no trick would work and he would explode like a balloon.
The reality of the situation finally sank in as Vritra sensed how terrifying this energy was. It was so dense and vast in amount that just a little could kill him.
{Sin Point Gained: Ambushed +3}

The moment the explosion had occurred, Vanessa teleported Vritra to another location, as they barely avoided getting caught by the three demonic generals who were charging toward them with dangerous attacks charged up.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
WHOOOOOOOOOSH!!
BAAANNNNGGGGGG!!
Three loud explosions sounded from the distance, but Vritra or Yasmine had no time to pay it any attention as they focused their entire attention on stopping the rampage of this darn core.
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +3}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +3}

"T- Try your best to converge the energy, I will do the same. Just focus on this and I will keep the nosy demons away," Yasmine said as she focused on forcing all the energy back into the core while also teleporting him to different locations every couple of seconds.
Right then, like a true savior, it arrived.
[Mutamorphis Activated!!]
