chapters.title: Chapter 144: Switch
paragraphs: "..." Vritra gritted his teeth as he tried his best to push back this energy, but there was absolutely no result. Even with their combined effort, they could barely make any change.
While most of Yasmine’s attention was on teleporting him and keeping those generals away.
Right then, like a true savior, it arrived.
[Mutamorphis Activated!!]

At the same time, the Essence Core in his body reacted. Sensing the vast demonic energy, it seemed to be filled with joy as it hungrily began to devour the energy, pulling the resisting Demon Lord’s Essence Core towards itself.
[Observing the body condition.]
[Calculating danger.]
[Level: Death!!]
The Mutamorphis worked rapidly as it tried to find the best possible solution to this impossibly difficult task. It scanned Vritra’s body again and again and finally:
[Solution Found!! Converging the demonic energy, process started...]
Suddenly, a strong pressure filled Vritra’s body, and all the rampaging energy was being forcefully pushed towards the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core.
The Demon Lord’s core resisted wildly. Vritra experienced extreme pain while his body was constantly being teleported from one corner of the kingdom to another at super-fast speed.

Now that the Mutamorphis had taken charge of the situation, Yasmine could finally focus on the task of keeping him away from the demon generals. Their strength might be much higher than hers right now, but she was a lot more experienced than any of them.

No matter what they did, she was always one step faster and kept Vritra safe while he was struggling to survive. His entire body glowed with a dark bluish light, veins bulging and body seeming to expand like a balloon.
Thankfully, with his new skillIntra Shuffle, his body could distort on its own when facing danger to keep him safe.

"..." Vritra gritted his teeth hard, tasting a metallic flavor in his mouth as he endured the pain that was enough to make most pass out. His internal organs were badly suffering under the violent nature of the demonic energy.
Even with the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core and Mutamorphis’s cooperation, it was taking some time to take charge of this core, which was slowly being pushed into his own Essence Core.

Only a few seconds had passed and Vritra seemed to have experienced a lifetime of suffering as he barely held onto his consciousness. Yasmine had also expended a large amount of energy, but more than that, she felt a heartache as she watched Vritra suffer so badly.
She really wished to transfer all that pain to herself but... she felt powerless and was unable to do anything. Filled with rage, she moved him far away from the demons and asked with worry:
"Hubby, can you hear me? Just... just endure a bit longer, I am sure you will be fine..." From her voice, it seemed as if it was her who was feeling all that pain in Vritra’s instance.
Yasmine would have never thought she would ever care so much about anyone after her parents had died, but watching him suffer made her feel terrible.

The three demonic generals were frustrated as they ran all over the place, chasing the unseen thief everywhere only to be met with emptiness. Whoever it was definitely had the ability to control space to some extent, so it might be a Legion-ranked person.
"Don’t stop, we have to get that thief." Thaddeus roared as he flew forward, full of killing intent, with the two others following behind him. He was the fastest of the three.

Both of Vritra’s hands exploded at the same time, and even his skills couldn’t help him much with that. Even with rapid healing, his internal organs were a complete mess. Blood was constantly flowing out of his eyes, nose, ears, and mouth, while his body twisted in pain; even the pain resistance passive skill couldn’t cancel out this level of suffering.
After more than thirty seconds had passed and Vritra finally succumbed to unconsciousness, another message popped in front of him.
[Danger controlled for now.]
[You have acquired the Hybrid Skill ’Switch’!!]

The Demon Lord’s core entered the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core, and all its energy was finally restrained as another level of barrier formed around it by the Mutamorphis, which was related to his new hybrid skill.

Finally, as the energy got in control for now, Yasmine removed all the traces of the demonic energy from his body and teleported him far away from his last location after completely wiping off all the traces that could lead the demon generals to him.

Then she hid him close to the labyrinth, before bringing him to the lowest level where the three soul wraiths were hard at work. Despite the messy and dangerous situation, Yasmine had already formed connections between several things that appeared to be random.

Like the appearance of the demons in this kingdom, them bringing this Demon Lord core, and the presence of this labyrinth in the Dunshire Kingdom— all of this was related, and those three were definitely here to bring back the dead Demon Lord.

Yasmine threw all those thoughts out of her mind as she flew out of Vritra’s body and scanned his body with worried eyes. She called out to him several times, but he was unconscious, while his body was healing from all the major injuries he had just received.
Yasmine could directly access Vritra’s inventory since he had allowed it, so she hastily brought several healing potions and made him drink them.
"Hubby..."

His hands grew back at a speed clearly visible, and all the other major internal organs also began to repair. After feeding him enough healing potion, Yasmine heaved a sigh of relief, as he was finally out of danger and was now just very exhausted.

Yasmine looked at the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core, observing it for any sign of eruption or danger. She was already quite wary of this thing being present in her husband’s body, but now the danger had increased exponentially.
But it was also because of that Essence Core that Vritra was able to survive. If he didn’t have that, then just the Switch and barrier provided by the Mutamorphis might not have been enough.

"In the future, hubby would have to be extremely careful. If this thing erupts, it would bring great chaos everywhere." Yasmine sighed. Even though she had killed a couple of Demon Lords in the past, they can’t be underestimated.

She wondered if Vritra obtaining this core while being so weak was a bane or boon, but for now, everything seemed to be in control. Her eyes were full of exhaustion, so she wrapped herself around Vritra and got to sleep, after glancing at the soul wraiths who were fighting against the horde of demons.
The three Demon Generals suddenly halted in the sky, their eyes wide open with shock and fear.
Rothellis, Silquor, and Morvik all glanced at one another, the panic clearly visible on their faces.

They couldn’t believe that someone was capable of integrating with that powerful core in such a short time. It hadn’t even been a minute since it was stolen, and they could no longer sense its presence.
Even they would never be able to achieve this feat, so it could only be someone at the level of a Demon Lord.
"Our Lord is gone...?" Morvik spoke in a twisted voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: BBC
paragraphs: "Our Lord is gone...?" Morvik spoke in a twisted voice, feeling so enraged that he wanted to destroy the entire kingdom.

"Should we turn Dunshire upside down to find that thief bastard? He must still be in here. I don’t understand how he was able to control our Lord’s core so fast, but he definitely isn’t too strong," Silquor said, his old and frail body swaying in the air as if he had just aged a couple dozen years in an instant.

"No, we can’t do that. This might be a small kingdom without even a single Legion-ranked warrior, but even without doing anything we have attracted so many pesky bugs. What do you think will happen if we create even a little trouble?

Not to mention, we need this place to bring back our Lord. And if others were to know that the labyrinth is the hiding place of our Lord, they would remove every trace of it just to get rid of a future problem," Thaddeus said, even though he was the angriest in the group.

"Damnit, who would dare to steal the core right in front of us? It seems they had planned this for a long time, but how did they even get to know about this? Have any of you told your subordinates about our Lord’s core?" Morvik asked, his voice full of suspicion.
"No," the other two shook their heads at the same time. Why would they disclose such an important matter to anyone?
The three looked at each other skeptically. Either one of them was lying, or worse yet—one of the three generals just might be a traitor who couldn’t stay loyal to a dead general.
"Sigh. There is no point in doubting one another right now. We all know how loyal the three of us are to the Lord. Let’s search the entire kingdom for any traces.
Whether you find anything or not, we will gather right at the labyrinth after 12 hours," Thaddeus said as all of them flew in different directions, dangerous auras bubbling around their bodies.
Inside the labyrinth, Vritra and Yasmine both had a long and nice sleep. They slept for over twelve hours and finally woke up to the sound of fighting.

Vritra lazily opened his eyes and glanced around. His three soul wraiths were still busy fighting, while Yasmine rested over his body. It took him a few seconds before he remembered exactly what happened—he had accidentally swallowed the core of a Demon Lord.
After that, all he remembered was the intense pain. Vritra looked down at his messy clothes that were torn and covered in blood.

At least his body was perfectly fine now, without any injury. But inside his essence core, he could feel the presence of something... a very dangerous and explosive presence, which seemed like a time bomb.
"You are awake?" Yasmine’s tired voice came out. It would take more time for her to restore her energy.
"Yeah, are you fine?" Vritra asked as he caressed the head of the ethereal dragon resting over his body, releasing a long sigh.
"Fine?" As if a new energy had filled her body, Yasmine suddenly rose and looked at him with frustration, before venting out:
"I can’t even understand how you could attract so much trouble left and right. Let’s talk about the murder of the king—that’s definitely a big conspiracy, and now we have become a part of it.
The person that was hiding there, I’m not sure, but the stench I smelled there and how things were done, I have a strong feeling that it must be that lunatic cult—"
Vritra interrupted her, trying to lighten up the mood: "Lunatic cunt?"
"NO JOKES!!" Yasmine scolded.
"Okay, sorry." Vritra sat silently as Yasmine continued in a frustrated voice.
"Huff. The lunatic cult—or as it is called, Bone Blood Cult—" Yasmine spoke, and Vritra tried to lighten the mood again.
"BBC?"
"Sigh. Fine, please continue."
"Even if the Nine Pacts is evil and causes trouble everywhere, at least they have a motive—a goal they wish to achieve and go to any lengths to reach it. But Bone Blood Cult is completely different.

Every person in there is a lunatic who wants nothing more than to cause trouble, see bloodshed everywhere, and they are the most fucked up in the brain. If you believe Nine Pacts is evil, then understand they are only 1% evil compared to those crazy people.

Those cultists might not be as strong as the Golden Moon or Nine Pacts, but they are just as dangerous—if not more," Yasmine said, and Vritra finally became serious. He understood that the whole situation was extremely dangerous.
"And now somehow we are caught up in a plan of theirs. Killing the king will definitely cause a lot of trouble, and this trouble might end up on our heads too.

Next, with how much I know about the people at the top of the Nine Pacts— even though all you had killed were lowest-ranked members— it is a stain for them, and they value their fearsome reputation a great deal. I’m sure they must have already sent at least one team of strong men to hunt us down.
Sigh. Next, those three demon generals... they are way too strong for the current you.

If we end up being caught by them, then death would be the biggest mercy they could show us. I can’t believe there are three top-level powers at play in this kingdom, and we are somehow intertwined with all three of them," Yasmine finally finished her banter.
"Looks like my plan to leave this kingdom peacefully won’t be coming true. If we avoid the three demon generals, then we would be fine.

As for BBC—since they are lunatics, how can we predict how they will act? And as for Nine Pacts, they would need some time to find me, right? That just means we have to leave this kingdom as soon as possible," Vritra spoke, feeling a headache.
"Before we deal with any of those, we need to set up some rules, since you are carrying a bomb in your body," Yasmine interrupted.
"Uh... sure, go ahead." He nodded.
"Even though that core is currently covered by a barrier, there is a chance it might erupt at some point. So you have to be careful not to let anything affect that core.

Keep your emotions in check—when you are asleep or... or unconscious. Yes, especially when you are unconscious, you have to be even more careful. If that power really gets out, then along with you, this kingdom and much more might turn into ashes," Yasmine spoke solemnly.
"I understand..." Vritra nodded, though he wasn’t sure how he was supposed to control it if he was unconscious. Then he added, "Is there anything else?"
"Yes, can you try not to get into trouble? Especially such dangerous ones?" Yasmine said weakly, before getting back to resting over him.
"...I will try." Vritra shrugged his shoulder. He then glanced at the soul wraiths as they slaughtered the countless demons.

After resting for a bit longer, it was finally time to return to the castle. Too much had happened in just one night, and the danger bar had gone to the highest point. They had to get out of the kingdom as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Disappeared
paragraphs: Vritra carefully made his way back to the castle. Even though more than twelve hours had passed in the labyrinth, only a little over two hours had passed outside. It was still dark.
He returned to his room and took a bath, then he returned to his bed. Vritra couldn’t sleep for the remainder of the night, as he just lay there thinking of various possibilities.

If that BBC cult was as twisted as Yasmine said, then they just might try to drag him into even more danger. Psychos like that would love nothing more than seeing others fight and suffer. There was danger from all sides.
As the sky turned bright, Vritra anxiously waited for any kind of change, but nothing out of the ordinary happened. Not even the news of the king’s death had been leaked yet.
After his bath and getting dressed, Vritra told Vanessa about the change in their schedule. He even told her about the shocking news of the king’s death and a bit about the danger.
Vanessa knew that with her power she couldn’t make a difference, and his decision seemed to be the best. She accepted all his words without saying anything.
After that, Vritra went to meet Fiona. The beautiful girl was pleasantly surprised to see her boyfriend right as she walked out of her room. She jumped into his arms and gave him a kiss.
The two entered her room, and Vritra told her about the changes in the plan. She was surprised, but she too accepted and began to prepare to leave early.
Finally, Vritra went to meet the goddess, who was just about to go meet her worshippers who had come there to pray to her.
"Is everything alright?" Diana asked as she watched Vritra act a bit differently than usual. His playful side seemed to be missing.
"There is a change in the plans. We will be leaving the kingdom right as it gets dark," Vritra said after Diana had formed a barrier around them.
"Huh? Did something really happen?" Diana asked with concern in her tone. There wasn’t much that could make this Demon Monarch this anxious.

"Yes, the king is dead, and... well, more danger is approaching. It would be better to leave this place as soon as possible," Vritra added while massaging his temples. He should have just gathered the three women together instead of relaying the message one at a time.
"W-What?!! Alfred is dead? Who could have killed him? D-Don’t tell me you did it?" Diana asked suspiciously.

"Of course I didn’t. I went into his room and I found him dead there. Anyway, make the preparations. We will be leaving tonight," he replied with a shake of his head. Previously, he did plan to kill the king, but someone else got to it before him.
"Wait, won’t that make us seem suspicious? Investigations will be carried out as soon as the news leaks, and we might be the first suspects," Diana said with a frown.

"Even if we stay here, we would only be waiting for death. So don’t try to use your brain and do as I told you. Make sure everything is ready by tonight," Vritra said before leaving her behind. Diana canceled the prayer time and instead began to prepare.

It was the calm before the storm. Vritra went back to his room and sat down beside his mother. He glanced at the system panel and saw that there was still more than one day left before the merging of the Divine Sin Arrow completed.
It would have been better if that thing got ready—maybe it could have increased his chances of survival.
But it is what it is.
He had prepared as much as he could, and the rest depended on luck. And Vritra’s luck was as good as the smell from a gutter full of rotting corpses and shit, on most occasions.
"Honey, everything will be fine. I wish I could help you in any way." Vanessa sat beside him with an upset look on her face. She had never seen her son being so anxious.

"I know, Mom. Don’t worry, I can handle this much." Vritra smiled at his mother, and the two soon began to eat lunch. He wished to spend some peaceful time with her—after all, the night was going to be extremely dangerous.
After eating and chatting about random calming things, Vritra and Vanessa walked out of the temple to take a walk around as usual.
They were just walking when Vritra saw the twin brothers walking toward the temple with a lost expression on their faces.

Paro and Taro had gone out with Max to have a drink since he seemed quite broken; he wasn’t himself. After drinking quite a bit last night, the three were completely wasted and slept on the streets. But when they woke up, Max had disappeared. People said that they had seen a few burly men dragging him along with them.
They tried to search for him everywhere but couldn’t. They informed the guards, who took up the search for Max.

But much to the disappointment of the two teenagers, no news about Max would be found until a few days later. And even then, they would only obtain the news that Max had been sold in a slave market to a strange old man with strange fetishes.
And exactly one month later, Max’s corpse was found.

Back to the present—the twins seemed quite depressed as they walked forward without any motivation. But suddenly, their eyes widened as the two saw the most seductive woman they had ever seen, like the most beautiful succubus straight out of any fantasy.
"..." The two froze and stared absentmindedly at Vanessa, and finally Taro asked, "Janito—Cough—Vritra, who is this?"
"..." Vritra, who was already in a bad mood, chose to ignore them as he took Vanessa’s hand and began walking in the opposite direction.
But the twins were way too curious as they walked behind them and asked one of the guards about it—only to be shocked by the news.
"W-What?!! That’s his mother?" The two were quite shocked. She always looked very beautiful and hot, but right now her charms were already off the charts—much higher than any woman on Earth.
"H-Hey Vritra, can we talk to you?" Taro was the first to speak as he walked hastily. Previously, they were afraid of Vanessa on Earth, but here, they were a lot more confident in themselves.
"FUCK OFF!" Vritra frowned and held back. He already had a lot on his plate and just wanted some peaceful time with Vanessa.
"Tch. You janitor, just stay silent. Hello ma’am, my name is Paro and you look quite beautiful, do you think we can—" Paro began to speak, but the next moment...
WHOOSH
The sound of a blade tearing through the air was heard, and Vritra cut off Paro’s hand with a sword made of dust. But no blood spurted as all of it was kept away by the Sand of Blood.

Paro was frozen with terror. For a moment, he couldn’t understand anything. As he looked down at his severed right arm, his eyes were filled with pain and horror—but just as he opened his mouth to let out a painful wail, dust poured into his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Angry Goddess?
paragraphs: "Mom, go back." Vritra said without turning, as he stood in front of the twins. One was screaming in agony while the other was frozen in shock and fear.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Cared for +1}
Vanessa sighed and nodded; she didn’t really care what happened to the twins, but she didn’t want Vritra to get into trouble because of these two bugs.
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +2}

Under the terrified gazes of the twins, Vanessa walked away without a care in the world. She supported her son in whatever he wanted; even if it was to slaughter everyone in this new world. After all, no one else mattered to her more than him.

Vanessa walked away, but the guards had heard the screams of the boy who had fallen to his knees and was crying while clutching his severed arm. They were shocked at first—no one could just cause trouble inside the castle—and it seemed to be a fight between the heroes from another world.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +28}

Several guards hastily ran forward to stop the fight. The twins were one of the best candidates, while Vritra seemed to have a very good relationship with the goddess, so they couldn’t choose sides. Their only task was to stop the fight.
But before the guards could arrive, Vritra continued with his beating.
"What were you saying?" He looked at Taro and asked, while lots of dust flooded into Paro’s mouth, making him suffocate as his eyes turned blood red.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +2}

"I– I was wrong, s– stop it. H– Help me someone." Taro screamed, but Vritra just shot the dust sword forward. It pierced through Taro’s chest and pinned him to the wall, and his screams were muffled by the dust too.

"Sigh. Even if I don’t do anything, why is trouble always around me? These shitty pieces of garbage, why were you in such a hurry to die when you could have survived just by staying shut?" Vritra cursed before forming another sword and sending it flying towards Paro.
The other boy was pinned to the ground as the sword pierced through his back.
"Stop that, you can’t kill them." Several guards finally arrived. They looked at the twins with aggrieved expressions—they might get punished for not solving the situation properly.
But there was still hope. If the twins could survive...
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +30}
"Just come with us. I am sure you will be fine with the connection you have with the goddess." Another guard said. They had to arrest Vritra for the act, even if just as a formality.
"Hoo... Get lost." Vritra released a long breath before speaking to the guards. Then he gazed at the twins and said: "Very soon, Max will be arriving to meet you up there."
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +2}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +2}
Paro and Taro watched in horror. Immense pain was coursing through their bodies, yet they couldn’t even let out a single word.
"No, don’t!! Stoopppppp—" The guards were baffled as Vritra paid them no attention, and in the next moment, the bodies of the twins—with terror in their eyes—exploded with dust.
Pieces of their flesh and blood flew everywhere. All the guards were frozen at the gruesome sight.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +32}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +32}
"H– How dare you?" The guards were filled with anger. Despite their warnings, Vritra just went ahead and killed them both.
"Guards, arrest him. We can’t let a criminal walk around." The guard commander arrived and ordered.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +33}

"Sigh. Just take care of the corpses. Why do you want to join them and make someone else do the same for you?" Vritra shook his head. He didn’t plan to kill every single guard—many of them were innocents who were just doing their work.

But some were from the third group when they had gone to the labyrinth. In that group, a few people like their teacher Mia had died. So he decided to set an example and scare the other guards away by killing them—though he knew this would only make the situation more messy.

Forming a long whip of dust, Vritra swung it before the others had the chance to attack. With lightning-fast speed, it flashed in the air and in the next moment, four heads hit the ground with a thud before rolling around.
{Sin Point Gained: Terrified +35}
"G– Gather everyone, he’s gone crazy!"
Just as Vritra had expected, these guards weren’t going to stop despite seeing the power difference. As more guards approached, a cold voice descended from not far away.
"What do you all think you are doing?" The goddess hovered in the air as she gazed down at the mortals, her eyes filled with arrogance.
"G– Goddess? He killed the twins and many guards, we have to—" the guard commander began to explain.
"Shut up. So what if he killed the twins and a few of you? His life is way more important than all of yours combined. Do you think you could do anything even if the entire army attacked?

You lowly guards, just do the cleaning and return to your work. Of course, if you still have justice left in your heart, then I will personally pull that heart out to reward it and hang your body outside the castle so others can learn from you."
Diana said, her eyes glazing with fire. She cursed these stupid guards who thought they amounted to anything.
"..." All the people were bewildered. They never thought that the graceful and holy goddess could ever say words like that. All of them gulped in fear and lost all motivation.
Vritra had sent a signal to Diana earlier, sending a small dust bird to fly towards her which delivered his message.
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +47}
"Let’s go." Diana nodded at Vritra. Probably only she knew how terrifying he really was; but even she wasn’t sure just how much of his strength he was hiding.
And so the lives of the guards were saved. After the two had left, they looked at one another and soon got to work and began to clean the place.
"Is everything ready?" Vritra asked in an emotionless tone.

"Almost, but it will be by night time." Diana answered respectfully. By now, she had accepted her role as his personal maid. So what if she is a goddess? Vritra is certainly something far more terrifying—what’s the shame in following someone like that?
{Sin Point Gained: Craved +1}
Not to mention that sweet sweet—cough!
"How many paths are there that lead to the Blue Kingdom?" Vritra asked.

"There are two main paths. One is direct and shorter, and the other is a bit longer, and we would be spending a few more days on the journey... and there is one more through the forest, which is equal to the direct path but more dangerous." She answered, before asking:
"Do you wish to make some changes to it?"
"No, we will be using the direct way. It wouldn’t make a difference. Moving through the forest just makes it easier to locate us." Vritra said after thinking for a moment.

sentences.text: "Mom, go back." Vritra said without turning, as he stood in front of the twins.
One was screaming in agony while the other was frozen in shock and fear.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Cared for +1}
Vanessa sighed and nodded; she didn’t really care what happened to the twins, but she didn’t want Vritra to get into trouble because of these two bugs.
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +2}
Under the terrified gazes of the twins, Vanessa walked away without a care in the world.
She supported her son in whatever he wanted; even if it was to slaughter everyone in this new world.
After all, no one else mattered to her more than him.
Vanessa walked away, but the guards had heard the screams of the boy who had fallen to his knees and was crying while clutching his severed arm.
They were shocked at first—no one could just cause trouble inside the castle—and it seemed to be a fight between the heroes from another world.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +28}
Several guards hastily ran forward to stop the fight.
The twins were one of the best candidates, while Vritra seemed to have a very good relationship with the goddess, so they couldn’t choose sides.
Their only task was to stop the fight.
But before the guards could arrive, Vritra continued with his beating.
"What were you saying?" He looked at Taro and asked, while lots of dust flooded into Paro’s mouth, making him suffocate as his eyes turned blood red.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +2}
"I– I was wrong, s– stop it.
H– Help me someone." Taro screamed, but Vritra just shot the dust sword forward.
It pierced through Taro’s chest and pinned him to the wall, and his screams were muffled by the dust too.
"Sigh.
Even if I don’t do anything, why is trouble always around me?
These shitty pieces of garbage, why were you in such a hurry to die when you could have survived just by staying shut?" Vritra cursed before forming another sword and sending it flying towards Paro.
The other boy was pinned to the ground as the sword pierced through his back.
"Stop that, you can’t kill them." Several guards finally arrived.
They looked at the twins with aggrieved expressions—they might get punished for not solving the situation properly.
But there was still hope.
If the twins could survive...
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +30}
"Just come with us.
I am sure you will be fine with the connection you have with the goddess." Another guard said.
They had to arrest Vritra for the act, even if just as a formality.
"Hoo...
Get lost." Vritra released a long breath before speaking to the guards.
Then he gazed at the twins and said: "Very soon, Max will be arriving to meet you up there."
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +2}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +2}
Paro and Taro watched in horror.
Immense pain was coursing through their bodies, yet they couldn’t even let out a single word.
"No, don’t!!
Stoopppppp—" The guards were baffled as Vritra paid them no attention, and in the next moment, the bodies of the twins—with terror in their eyes—exploded with dust.
Pieces of their flesh and blood flew everywhere.
All the guards were frozen at the gruesome sight.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +32}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +32}
"H– How dare you?" The guards were filled with anger.
Despite their warnings, Vritra just went ahead and killed them both.
"Guards, arrest him.
We can’t let a criminal walk around." The guard commander arrived and ordered.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +33}
"Sigh.
Just take care of the corpses.
Why do you want to join them and make someone else do the same for you?" Vritra shook his head.
He didn’t plan to kill every single guard—many of them were innocents who were just doing their work.
But some were from the third group when they had gone to the labyrinth.
In that group, a few people like their teacher Mia had died.
So he decided to set an example and scare the other guards away by killing them—though he knew this would only make the situation more messy.
Forming a long whip of dust, Vritra swung it before the others had the chance to attack.
With lightning-fast speed, it flashed in the air and in the next moment, four heads hit the ground with a thud before rolling around.
{Sin Point Gained: Terrified +35}
"G– Gather everyone, he’s gone crazy!"
Just as Vritra had expected, these guards weren’t going to stop despite seeing the power difference.
As more guards approached, a cold voice descended from not far away.
"What do you all think you are doing?" The goddess hovered in the air as she gazed down at the mortals, her eyes filled with arrogance.
"G– Goddess?
He killed the twins and many guards, we have to—" the guard commander began to explain.
"Shut up.
So what if he killed the twins and a few of you?
His life is way more important than all of yours combined.
Do you think you could do anything even if the entire army attacked?
You lowly guards, just do the cleaning and return to your work.
Of course, if you still have justice left in your heart, then I will personally pull that heart out to reward it and hang your body outside the castle so others can learn from you."
Diana said, her eyes glazing with fire.
She cursed these stupid guards who thought they amounted to anything.
"..." All the people were bewildered.
They never thought that the graceful and holy goddess could ever say words like that.
All of them gulped in fear and lost all motivation.
Vritra had sent a signal to Diana earlier, sending a small dust bird to fly towards her which delivered his message.
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +47}
"Let’s go." Diana nodded at Vritra.
Probably only she knew how terrifying he really was; but even she wasn’t sure just how much of his strength he was hiding.
And so the lives of the guards were saved.
After the two had left, they looked at one another and soon got to work and began to clean the place.
"Is everything ready?" Vritra asked in an emotionless tone.
"Almost, but it will be by night time." Diana answered respectfully.
By now, she had accepted her role as his personal maid.
So what if she is a goddess?
Vritra is certainly something far more terrifying—what’s the shame in following someone like that?
{Sin Point Gained: Craved +1}
Not to mention that sweet sweet—cough!
"How many paths are there that lead to the Blue Kingdom?" Vritra asked.
"There are two main paths.

One is direct and shorter, and the other is a bit longer, and we would be spending a few more days on the journey... and there is one more through the forest, which is equal to the direct path but more dangerous." She answered, before asking:
"Do you wish to make some changes to it?"
"No, we will be using the direct way.
It wouldn’t make a difference.
Moving through the forest just makes it easier to locate us." Vritra said after thinking for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: The Journey Begins
paragraphs: "Uhm... if you don’t mind me asking, exactly who would be chasing us? Aside from the people who would investigate Alfred’s death, are there more?" Diana asked.
There was a high chance that the people who would come to investigate would be from the Golden Moon.
Most of those people aren’t as violent, so the situation shouldn’t be very bad.
"Hmm, just a few demon generals, Nine Pacts, a crazy cult... that must be all, at least what I am aware of," Vritra said casually.
Diana: "..."
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
After the day’s events, Vritra returned to his room and did nothing but rest. He met up with Fiona to see if she was ready.
Finally, it was around eight in the night and the sky had started to turn dark. Over three carriages had arrived outside the temple, all quite big and luxurious.

One carriage was left empty in case of some kind of emergency, another one was filled with guards that they would be bringing along. Taking these guards was important—if they just hastily ran out of the castle like that, it would make them look even more suspicious.

The first and biggest carriage would be the resting place for the three women and Vritra. Unlike his original plan, where he was going to leave after causing some trouble here, now he decided to head out with them.
That way, he would be able to protect them better.
"Are you all ready? This might be the last time we are in this place, so don’t leave anything important behind," Vritra asked as he glanced at the three women.
"Honey, I didn’t need to bring much and I don’t really have any attachment to this place, so yeah, I am ready," Vanessa replied with a smile.
"I have taken everything I could. I have emptied even everything the king collected. What is he going to do with them as a dead body?" Diana said, a big proud smile on her face.
’She is as greedy as ever. Because of her greed and arrogance, she ended up getting enslaved by me... sigh, she never learns.’ Vritra shook his head before asking:
"Taking all that—won’t that make us look more like suspects who killed the king just to steal it all?"
"Ah... s-should I put it back?" Diana looked at Vritra with a worried expression, chewing her lips nervously.
"Forget it. How about you, Fiona?" Vritra looked at the redhead and asked.
"Yes, everything I need is with me," Fiona said as she gazed at him possessively. Vritra was going with her—what could be more important than him?
"Good, then let’s head out and reach the Blue Kingdom... let’s hope without any trouble," Vritra said as the four walked towards the carriage that was at the center. It looked so royal.
"Heh, I doubt that. Poor mother-in-law, it would be better to leave without the trouble magnet, she might be more safe," Yasmine spoke, shaking her head.

’Hmm, that’s true. But I just can’t leave them. Sigh, let’s hope we can get out of here before they notice us.’ Vritra sighed as they climbed into the carriage, which looked just as majestic from the inside.
Twenty guards were present in the carriage ahead of them, while the third was empty. Without lingering around, the three carriages began to move.
Inside the carriage, it was bright with many comfortable seats, beds, and much more. Vritra sat beside the others and wondered if he could do anything to increase his strength.

The only thing was the Divine Sin Wheel, but using the points now would be just wasting them, and their enemies this time were much stronger. Vritra doubted any skill would give him enough of a boost that he could suddenly kill demon general-level enemies.
So he would have to make it all work with everything he possessed. Vritra again thanked the dead King Alfred for his generous parting gift—all four were god-tier.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra stabilized the demon core in his body that seemed ready to burst out at any moment. Thankfully, Mutamorphis and his own essence core were keeping it in check for now.

’Well, if things get too bad, I would just let it explode and bring all those people down with me. I still have that potion to revive me. If most of my body could be preserved after death, then Yasmine could do the rest.’ Vritra thought. Killing himself was the final trump card, but he didn’t tell this plan to Yasmine, as she would never agree.
But he was also sure when the time comes, she would understand it on her own and do her part.

The four chatted casually as they made their way out of the castle and soon arrived in the market, where countless people were watching them in awe and envy. This one carriage was worth more than all their wealth combined.
Vritra opened one of the windows and leaned toward the outside, letting the cold wind hit his face while sin points continued to rain from all the bystanders.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +142}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +141}
{Sin Point Gained: Jealous +155}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +23}
Vritra just closed his eyes as he talked with Diana, Vanessa, and Fiona and watched the sin points pour.

’Sigh, maybe I should just become a tourist and change the name to:Travelling around the world, my exp increases every day...’ Vritra thought and imagined that carefree life. Getting thousands of sin points every day and then getting new skills, increasing his strength secretly.
But that was just a pipe dream now. Shaking his head, he opened his eyes and saw the women among the crowd who kept sending strange looks at him.
{Sin Point Gained: Infatuated +67}
{Sin Point Gained: Liked +69}
Inside the castle, in Alfred’s room.
His corpse was still hanging on the wall with a sword piercing through his chest. The guards had not gone inside, just as they had been instructed by the king.
Maids would deliver the food and leave it right inside the door and would come later to collect it.
Right now, the room was completely dark and surrounded by a strong barrier, and ten figures could be seen sitting in a circle on the large sofa.
All of them wore red clothes and red masks. The clothes looked normal at first glance, but they were made from human skin, and the masks were formed from the bones of demons and humans.
The mask was white in color, and only their eyes and lips were visible. It had such a strange cut to show their lips for some reason.
Nine of them looked exactly the same, while only the mask of one person was different. His mask was like a laughing devil, and his red lips were visible in the lower part, showing his twisted smile.
These were the members of the Bone Blood Cult, just as Yasmine had speculated.

All ten of them had levels in several thousands, with the devil mask being the strongest in the group. They couldn’t match the demon generals but could overpower the team of the Nine Pacts that had already entered the Dunshire Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Contagious Calmness
paragraphs: "I heard something happened while you were completing your mission. Did someone from the Nine Pacts or those demon generals see you?" one of the nine men asked, looking at the devil-masked man whose name was ’Blunder’.

Blunder was given the task to lead this small team of ten and cause problems in the plans of all the groups acting in this kingdom, creating conflict between them. That was how they would be able to reap the benefits in the end and get a lot of new sacrifices.

"No, it wasn’t anyone from those groups. All of them are too busy with their own work. Keke, it was a fresh face. He arrived right when I was about to leave," Blunder replied. He twirled one of his fingers in the air, and something glistening could be seen on top of it.
"Did he see you? Did you kill him?" another man from the Bone Blood Cult asked with his brows raised.

"No and no, but he must have noticed me. Anyway, all the players have already entered the battlefield. It’s time for us to start controlling everything from behind," Blunder said as he stared intently at the tip of his finger.

"Are we going to go with our original plans?" one of the nine men asked. All of them were crazy, but Blunder was a psycho on just another level. He would go to any length to torture someone in every possible way once he had locked his eyes on them. All of them shivered as they saw their leader’s lips turn into a twisted smile.
"No, I plan on doing something even more interesting."
After a pause, he asked, "Nine Pacts... how long before they arrive close to this capital? And who among the top powers would come to investigate the murder of Aldric?"

"The Nine Pacts’ team will be here in about a day, or maybe less. As for the investigation, it should most probably be Golden Moon, but they wouldn’t be here until a few days have passed," answered one of the men.
"That’s a pity. I guess the only participants in this war would be Nine Pacts, Demon Generals, our cult, and him," Blunder said while showing the tip of his finger to everyone.
"Huh? Who is that?" one of them asked.
"Just a very interesting person," Blunder said as he glanced outside and watched the three carriages leave. His smile became even more twisted, as if his cheeks would be ripped in the next moment.
The drop of Vritra’s sweat glistened on his fingertip—the one thing that was going to create quite a bit of trouble for him and also make him quite popular by the end.
Back in the carriage, the four people chatted calmly and enjoyed this wonderful trip.
Diana was calm because she believed Vritra must be joking when he said so many enemies were chasing them. Seeing Vritra so calm, she also became calm.

Fiona was calm because she was the one who knew the least about the situation. Though Vritra had informed her about Alfred’s death and that strong enemies would be chasing them, seeing the two strongest people in their group—Vritra and Diana—being so calm, she obviously felt safe and completely relaxed. Even Vanessa, who should be around her level, didn’t seem nervous, so why should she be nervous or anxious?

Vanessa was calm as well. Though she knew the danger was high, she doubted that if it were something unsolvable, then her son and the goddess wouldn’t be so calm. So she acted as if everything was normal.

On the other hand, Vritra was surprised that despite knowing the dangers of their situation, the three women could still remain so calm. So as a man, how could he be the one to show fear? Whatever might come, they would face it—and so Vritra acted calm to raise everyone’s morale.

Only Yasmine was going crazy over the situation. The danger level this time was so much higher. They were literally facing a few of the most dangerous organizations and even a crazy cult, while their journey had barely begun. She wondered why no one in the group seemed anxious.
Happy happy and calm calm trip continued on its merry way, collecting sin points and making people envious all the way.
Soon, the three women went to bed. Vanessa and Diana had noticed how Fiona looked at Vritra. They knew she was experiencing the joy of her first love and had already fallen far too deep for him.
Diana didn’t have any problem with this—she was just Vritra’s maid, so whoever he wanted to be with, he could.

While Vanessa supported her son unconditionally in whatever he did—even if it was raise a goddess as his slave or take this beautiful redhead as his woman—she would even push the two closer. Of course, that didn’t mean their relationship would change again. They had already formed a lifelong bond and were husband and wife.
Vritra watched the three women go to sleep. He had already closed the window as he lay down on his bed as well, staring at the ceiling of the carriage.
’I wonder if it will happen tonight or after a day or maybe later,’ Vritra wondered. One thing he knew for sure was they wouldn’t be able to leave this place so easily.

"If I’m not wrong, then tonight should be safe, but soon there would be a big mess in this kingdom, and we just might be at the centre of it." Yasmine laughed at the absurdity of the situation. Of course, after seeing his skill, anyone would get interested in Vritra—not to mention those crazy cultists who are always looking around to find something more interesting and insane.

’Sigh, it would be better if they arrive after theDivine Sin Arrowis merged. It’s taking too damn long. This thing better be satisfying, or I will shove another arrow up its ass.’ Vritra looked at the level-up message before closing his eyes.
The night really passed rather peacefully. The carriage stopped only for a couple of short breaks and continued to move towards the Blue Kingdom.

Vritra barely opened the window and looked outside to earn his daily sin points when the carriages moved through the crowded parts. He closed the window when they were passing through the forest paths.

The guards in the first carriage were quite bored. It was a long journey, and they weren’t even taking many breaks. But being bored was much better than getting their blood pumped before getting killed.
The twenty guards sat in the carriage and looked outside. Right now, they were passing through the forest area, and there were no people around for at least a few miles.
"Huh? Why is the third carriage separating from us?" one of the guards spoke up, gathering the others’ attention as he pointed outside.

The third carriage, which was empty, had changed its path and moved into the forest for some reason. The guards were confused, but they kept their questions to themselves and just stayed idle until the need arose.
"I wonder what they are planning." Another guard glanced back at the carriage behind them, which had even its windows shut for several hours, unlike usual.

One thing he knew for sure was they wouldn’t be able to leave this place so easily.
"If I’m not wrong, then tonight should be safe, but soon there would be a big mess in this kingdom, and we just might be at the centre of it." Yasmine laughed at the absurdity of the situation.
Of course, after seeing his skill, anyone would get interested in Vritra—not to mention those crazy cultists who are always looking around to find something more interesting and insane.
’Sigh, it would be better if they arrive after theDivine Sin Arrowis merged.
It’s taking too damn long.
This thing better be satisfying, or I will shove another arrow up its ass.’ Vritra looked at the level-up message before closing his eyes.
The night really passed rather peacefully.
The carriage stopped only for a couple of short breaks and continued to move towards the Blue Kingdom.
Vritra barely opened the window and looked outside to earn his daily sin points when the carriages moved through the crowded parts.
He closed the window when they were passing through the forest paths.
The guards in the first carriage were quite bored.
It was a long journey, and they weren’t even taking many breaks.
But being bored was much better than getting their blood pumped before getting killed.
The twenty guards sat in the carriage and looked outside.
Right now, they were passing through the forest area, and there were no people around for at least a few miles.
"Huh?
Why is the third carriage separating from us?" one of the guards spoke up, gathering the others’ attention as he pointed outside.
The third carriage, which was empty, had changed its path and moved into the forest for some reason.
The guards were confused, but they kept their questions to themselves and just stayed idle until the need arose.
"I wonder what they are planning." Another guard glanced back at the carriage behind them, which had even its windows shut for several hours, unlike usual.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Blunder
paragraphs: The three carriages continued to move through the forest at their usual pace. The next city was a bit further away, so over half of the night would be spent in the forest.
Most of the guards had fallen asleep by now. They doubted anyone would dare to attack the carriages with the royal symbol, so they just needed to drop the four people at the border.

The sky was dark, and the forest was unusually quiet. Vritra sat on the comfortable seat with his head leaning back and his eyes closed. His arms rested over the armrest as he tapped on it with his finger, feeling the chilly air of the night.
Suddenly, the dark sky was covered by silhouettes of thousands of men, all of them circling around the peacefully moving carriages.
They wore black robes with black masks on their faces. Six people were leading the large group. The air suddenly became suffocatingly thick with bloodlust.
Aside from these thousands of men from the Nine Pacts, the three demon generals arrived in the sky as they gazed at the people from the Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult.
Yes, the ten people from the Bone Blood Cult had also arrived there along with thousands of men dressed in red clothes. Their bloodlust made the space around them twist.
Thousands upon thousands of people were floating in the sky at this time. Flying was a skill that people at their levels could easily buy and learn.
Learning skills in such a manner became possible only because of the creation of the Glyph by Rodrick Mech—one of the biggest inventions in history.
Despite the sudden presence of more than twenty thousand men, where even the minimum level was above five hundred, the two carriages continued to move just as before.

"Which among you bastards was it? The humans are as vicious as ever. Did the Nine Pacts decide to backstab us? Or was it the sniffing dogs from the Bone Blood Cult?" Thaddeus was the first to break the silence among the three top powers.

Vritra, with his eyes closed, activated the Nether Eyes as he observed the sky and sighed. What bad luck that all of them had actually arrived so fast. He had hoped that they would have come at least a day or two later.
After midnight, theDivine Sin Arrowwould have finished its merging process—but it was a pity.
Vritra tried to gauge their levels with his appraisal but failed. The difference in level was just so big. But from their auras, he could tell which among them were the strongest.
The three demon generals were definitely at the top. Their levels were so high that they could make the entire Dunshire Kingdom disappear within moments.
Then the people from the Nine Pacts—they were slightly weaker than the demon generals, but their strength was still very high, capable of crushing BOB with a tap of their fingers.
And at last, the Bone Blood Cult—with the most dense killing intent. A legion- or Myriad-rank was nothing to them. They had surpassed that level hundreds of years ago.
The Nine Pacts’ army had more than ten thousand men, and the same was true for the lunatics of the BBC, most of whose members were on the lower side of the levels.
At the center of it all was Vritra, with his low level that seemed like nothing in front of all those people.
"Demon Generals, you’d better stay out of our business. The deal between us was nullified the moment you ignored our request in search of the person who destroyed our base.
Don’t act recklessly unless you want to anger the entire Nine Pacts," a man in a completely black dress, with a mask that didn’t have any face on it, stepped forward and replied to the demon general.

"Tsk, that would depend on whether the thief is from the Nine Pacts or not, and I’m going to find that out after beating the shit out of both your organizations," Silquor spoke, waving his torn-out sleeves around.
Despite their high status and great strength, the three demon generals still wore these old dresses that were given to them by their lord as gifts.

"Hahahaha! This is going to be so much fun. Bone Blood Cult is going to kill the faceless from the Nine Pacts and three demon generals today." Blunder laughed hideously as he glared at the two organizations.

"We from the Nine Pacts don’t wish to fight the demon generals. We have no idea about who stole your lord’s demon core—" Faceless from the Nine Pacts began to speak but suddenly halted, as he turned his gaze towards Blunder and glared.
"Oh!! And how exactly did you get this news? If you’re not the thief, then you certainly know who is, am I right?" Morvik said, his hissing voice making others’ ears hurt.
Previously, Faceless had gotten a letter from the Bone Blood Cult. It was given to him directly by Blunder.

The Bone Blood Cult couldn’t be trusted, so he was quite reluctant to open it at first, but in exchange for some information, the only condition Blunder had put forward was not to intervene in the fight between the three demon generals and the Bone Blood Cult.
So Faceless from the Nine Pacts had agreed to this condition. When he opened the letter, there was information about the person they were here to search for—Vritra.
But it was just a coincidence, or probably Vritra’s bad luck. Blunder had just given his name away so that he could get Vritra involved in this great battle.
But unknowingly, he had given out the right information. That was exactly how the Nine Pacts were able to find Vritra so easily. But there was one more piece of news written in the letter—
News about the reason why the three demon generals had come to this place, and that the Demon Lord’s core had been stolen by someone.
At that time, Faceless couldn’t understand why Blunder had added such an important piece of information for free. But he decided to accept it as a gift of their cooperation.
After all, what damage could a piece of information cause?
But now he remembered that nothing in this world was free. Just having that info in his mind had put everyone from the Nine Pacts into danger and against the three demon generals.

Of course, Faceless wasn’t going to just reveal this information even if he knew it. But Blunder had a power to lead people without them having any idea they were being led—quite similar to natural hypnosis but much stronger.
Just now, he had fallen into Blunder’s plan. Faceless could only curse the man before sighing and speaking:

"Yeah, I’m sorry, but I couldn’t share any more information about that core because of the promise I made with the Bone Blood Cult—to Blunder. We had made a deal. That’s why I’ve decided to end our cooperation. You can do whatever you want with those lunatics. My only target is him."
Faceless looked at the carriages that seemed to be moving much slower now under the pressure of so many people, he still seemed calm from his voice; unafraid of the dangerous generals.
